name: v1.4.251
body:
## Richer phone chats, add-to-chat from anywhere & steadier terminals ✨

- 📱 **Much more chat on the phone:** Rewind to an earlier message, continue a stopped reply, pin the agent's plan above the composer, paste images and long text, manage a chat's goal and see context usage, with unsent drafts kept across an app restart.
- 📎 **Add anything to chat:** Send a selection from a file, a Markdown preview or a terminal to any agent in the workspace, or start a new agent with it.
- 🔁 **Chats pick up after a restart:** New installs resume working chats automatically after Orca quits or updates, and resuming is more reliable for everyone who has it on.
- 🤖 **Workers can start their own workers:** Nested workers are allowed by default, finished workers can keep messaging their coordinator, and stopping a worker stops its helpers.
- ⚡ **Faster everyday work:** Launch skips a second login-shell capture, source control and the tab bar do less repeated work, and long chats stay responsive.
- 🖥️ **Steadier terminals:** Terminals re-attach after a daemon reconnect, survive a busy app, and new GPU canvases no longer flash blank.
- 🗂️ **Easier project organization:** Collapse or expand all projects, create a child worktree from the context menu and refresh folder project groups.

## Highlights

- **Chat:** Add a file, Markdown preview or terminal selection to a chat. Agent messages use one-line cards on desktop and phone, native chats appear in Cmd+J recents and title search, and Cmd/Ctrl+Enter on an empty composer steers the first queued message. Claude chats keep effort changeable after the first reply and clear a stuck "needs permission" status when Claude ends the request itself. Codex chats show `/usage` and subagent task names.
- **Phone:** Rewind and continue chats, pin the plan, paste images and long text, set and manage goals, see the context usage ring, follow background tasks, copy or share images, copy file paths, choose where links open, and sign in from a signed-out chat.
- **Orchestration:** Workers can start their own workers, keep messaging their coordinator after they finish, and stop their helpers when stopped. Mail waits for a draft you are typing, including in OpenCode and after a restart.
- **Performance:** Startup, source control conflict badges and branch compares, the tab bar, browser login detection, Pi terminal spawns and plugin catalog images all do less repeated work. Long chats no longer rescan their whole history on every status update. Chats with ACP agents also stop holding on to finished tool and message records for the chat's whole life.
- **Terminals & remote hosts:** Terminals re-attach after a daemon reconnect and keep their link through a main-process freeze. SSH explains when a host's server setup stops on a known cause and stops restarting a server that keeps crashing. Server actions reconnect a disconnected server.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Nested worker depth:** The default is now 4. Existing profiles set to 1 move to 4 on upgrade; you can set it back in Settings, and Orca keeps that choice.
- **Resume working chats after restart:** On by default for new installs only. Existing users keep their saved choice, and existing profiles that never chose stay off.
- **Claude permission status:** Clearing a "needs permission" status that Claude ended itself needs Claude 2.1.118 or later. Orca installs one more managed Claude hook for it; older Claude versions keep the previous behavior.
- **macOS updates:** Macs below a release's minimum macOS stay on their last compatible build and get a one-time notice. The minimum is still macOS 12, so nothing changes yet.
- **Chat UI menu:** "Fork Agent Session…" is no longer in Chat UI's menu. Terminals keep it.

---

name: Hermes Agent v0.23.0 — The Hearth Release
body:
# Hermes Agent v0.23.0

**Release Date:** November 5, 2026
**Since v0.22.0:** ~10,080 commits · ~1,950 merged PRs · ~8,720 files changed · ~725,200 insertions · ~201,400 deletions · **~850 issues closed** · 666 contributors

> **The Hearth Release.** In the old hymns Hermes kept the threshold and Hestia kept the hearth, and the two were honored side by side. v0.22.0 got newcomers through the door; v0.23.0 builds the fire they gather around. The headline: your whole Desktop workspace now opens in a browser tab, served by your own gateway. Underneath it, every conversation lives in one place: a single gateway owns each session, and the CLI, TUI, Desktop, editors, bots and cron all sit down at the same table instead of each running its own agent. From that one hearth, Desktop keeps every machine you run Hermes on connected at once, Group Chats route their own conversations, and the terminal finally draws your images inline and lets you rewind a conversation. Around it: plugins that keep themselves updated, price tags and spend limits on paid MCP tools, pluggable delegation, a plugin catalog that grew from about 600 to over 1,050 entries, a leaner built-in skill set, and a long run of memory and latency work for long-lived gateways. This release rolls up and fully documents the v0.22.1–v0.22.7 patch releases.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

---

## ✨ Highlights

- **Your Desktop workspace in a browser tab** — The new Webapp serves the full Desktop workspace from your own gateway: the same chats, Group Chats, plugins and settings, in any browser on your network or behind a public URL with sign-in. The Docker image and Nix package ship it. It is off by default; turn it on with `webapp.enabled` or Web Access in Settings. ([#141864](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/141864), [#145598](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145598), [#145536](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145536), [#145072](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145072), [#145153](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145153) — @jquesnelle, @BearHuddleston, @IAvecilla, @Adolanium)

- **One gateway owns every conversation** — Before, the CLI, TUI, Desktop, editors (ACP), messaging bots and cron could each run their own copy of the agent against the same chat, which is how messages got written twice or went missing between surfaces. Now each machine runs one gateway that owns every session, and every surface attaches to it as a client: a chat you open anywhere is the same chat, with one queue and one history. You can even steer or edit a queued prompt from Desktop without it running twice. ([#106742](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/106742), [#140334](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/140334) — @unsupportedpastels, @kshitijk4poor)

- **Pictures in the terminal** — When you paste an image, or a tool takes a screenshot, the CLI and TUI now draw it right in the chat instead of printing a file path: real pixels in kitty and Ghostty (CLI and TUI) and in iTerm2, WezTerm and Konsole (CLI), coloured blocks everywhere else, and full resolution in VS Code's terminal when its image support is on. ([#147293](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147293), [#148874](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148874) — @Adolanium)

- **Rewind a conversation** — Press Esc twice or type `/rewind` in the TUI or classic CLI, pick an earlier message, then edit and resend it or fork a new session from that point. The original session stays exactly as it was. The TUI can also start `/new` while a turn is still running; the old one keeps working in the background. ([#144937](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144937), [#148880](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148880) — @SaguaroDev)

- **Every machine in one Desktop window** — Desktop now keeps all your gateways connected at once, so switching between this computer and an SSH or remote gateway is instant. Terminal tabs run on the host they were opened on, and a Group Chat can mix bots from different machines. ([#147681](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147681), [#147708](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147708), [#148418](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148418) — @dskwe, @janviernine)

- **Group Chats that run themselves** — Bot Mode rooms can let a lead bot, or an automatic router, pick who answers a message that names nobody. Scheduled jobs can post into a room, rooms keep a purpose and shared notes, and bots no longer ping each other in endless loops. Rooms also look like a normal Hermes chat now, and each bot shows what it is doing live ("scout · terminal · 7s"). ([#144833](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144833), [#148417](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148417), [#148888](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148888), [#148903](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148903), [#148422](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148422) — @KoNit-K)

- **Plugins that keep themselves current** — `hermes plugins update` updates everything at once, and an opt-in Auto-update switch (CLI, chat, Desktop and dashboard) keeps catalog and git plugins up to date. Updates that would break your setup are held back instead of applied. The catalog itself grew from about 600 to over 1,050 entries, and a new Verified tier marks plugins built by the vendor itself. ([#141513](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/141513), [#85794](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/85794), [#143468](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143468), [#144257](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144257) — @charan-rathore, @YS-OH-CORE)

- **Price tags and spend limits for paid tools** — Paid MCP tools, such as 3D or media generation, can declare what a call costs. The approval prompt shows each call's price and the chat's running total, and Hermes asks before a chat goes over its limit, even in YOLO mode. ([#142470](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142470), [#143780](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143780), [#143795](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143795), [#143787](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143787) — @liuhao1024, @fangliquanflq)

- **New official plugins, and a smaller core** — Meshy (text and image to 3D), ElevenLabs Music and Sound Effects, X Chat, REA (reverse engineering) and a bubblewrap sandbox are now one-command installs. Camofox, `mcp-serve`, the agent importers and Singularity moved out of core into plugins that install themselves for anyone who used them. ([#142619](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142619), [#146294](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/146294), [#139725](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139725), [#143484](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143484), [#139983](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139983))

- **Choose how subagents are run** — Delegation is now pluggable: keep the default, or install the official `advanced-delegation` plugin to send each subagent task to a named model or into a separate profile. Switch with `/delegation`. ([#142563](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142563), [#142564](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142564), [#143423](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143423))

- **Lighter and faster, especially when Hermes runs all day** — Recurring cron jobs share a prompt cache, one-shot runs send about 1,570 fewer prompt tokens per call, and `patch`/`write_file` return in milliseconds with LSP on. Long-lived gateways now let go of closed sessions' memory, and the Desktop sidebar no longer slows down as sessions pile up (one store with ~35k cron runs went from a 121 s refresh to instant). ([#139876](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139876), [#144177](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144177), [#140387](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/140387), [#147863](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147863), [#137087](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/137087), [#147819](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147819), [#144940](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144940) — @kshitijk4poor)

- **A leaner skill set you can lock** — The built-in skills went from 58 to 44, with Word, PowerPoint and Excel merged into one `microsoft-office` skill. `hermes curator lock` stops the agent from rewriting a skill you curated by hand, through any tool, even in YOLO mode. ([#147557](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147557) — @daviseford)

- **Password managers and a keychain vault key** — Verified password-manager plugins can hand the browser your logins without seeing anyone else's, and the browser vault's key can now live in your OS keychain. ([#143964](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143964), [#144246](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144246) — @Jesssullivan)

- **Stop a running cron job** — Cancel a running job from the CLI, Desktop, the API or the agent itself, and set per job what happens to runs missed while Hermes was off. ([#144801](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144801) — @kokhlo, @fangliquanflq, @LeonSGP43)

## ⚠️ Upgrade notes

- **The old built-in browser tools are gone.** Browser automation runs on `browser_exec` only; agent-browser and the ten `browser_*` tools (`browser_navigate`, `browser_click`, ...) were removed. Homes that used Camofox get the `camofox` plugin installed automatically. If your own prompts, skills or toolset lists name the old tools, switch them to `browser_exec`. ([#143146](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143146))
- **Desktop needs macOS 13+ and 64-bit Windows.** The app moved to Electron 44, which no longer runs on macOS 11, macOS 12 or 32-bit Windows. ([#142727](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142727) — @OutThisLife, @Adihaliem)
- **`hermes mcp serve` is now `hermes mcp-serve`** (it moved into a plugin). MCP clients that launch Hermes as a server need their command updated; nothing rewrites it for you.
- **Word, PowerPoint and Excel skills are now one `microsoft-office` skill.** Old copies stay on disk until you remove them.
- **The Webapp is off by default.** Nothing is served to a browser until you turn on `webapp.enabled` or Web Access.

## 🧠 Core Agent, Gateway & Tools

### Providers & Models
- **GLM-5.3 is the default model when you never pick one** — The silent default moves from GLM-5.2 to GLM-5.3, at about the same price and with the same 1M context window on Nous Portal and OpenRouter. ([#144810](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144810) — @calvinnwq)
- **New models** — GPT-6.1 Terra, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 and Gemini 4 Argon on Solstice. Claude Mythos is treated as always-thinking, so reasoning-off requests stop failing their first try. Nemotron 3.5 Super VL gets default parameters. ([#145204](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145204), [#140496](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/140496), [#139466](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139466), [#148127](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148127), [#138462](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/138462) — @benbarclay, @unsupportedpastels, @rroverin)
- **Usage-window plans** — On subscriptions that track usage as allowances instead of credits, `/usage` shows one bar per allowance with its reset time. Pickers list the plan's recommended models first, tag them Large or Free, and say when an allowance has run out. ([#142308](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142308), [#145682](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145682) — @rob-maron)
- **Daybreak for approved ChatGPT subscriptions** — An off-by-default `agent.daybreak` switch turns on OpenAI's Trusted Access for Cyber program. It only appears on models that your account's own Codex catalog lists as approved, and it is checked again on every request. ([#148056](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148056) — @unsupportedpastels, @Froraut)
- **`/model reset`** — Takes a session pinned with `/model` back to your configured default without losing the conversation, in the CLI, TUI, Desktop and messaging. ([#80448](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/80448) — @shannonsands)
- **GitHub Copilot moved to a labs plugin** — Copilot (`copilot`, `copilot-acp`) now lives in the `github-copilot` Hermes Labs plugin, which profiles that use Copilot install automatically. Core keeps generic provider hooks that any provider plugin can use. ([#144788](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144788))
- **Custom endpoints resolve reliably** — New profiles inherit `custom:<name>`, `${VAR}` and legacy custom endpoints instead of failing with "Unknown provider". Resumed chats stay on the endpoint that served them, and a built-in provider's key no longer leaks onto a custom entry with the same name. ([#138513](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/138513), [#139947](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139947), [#140335](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/140335), [#147761](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147761) — @jquesnelle, @unsupportedpastels)
- **Provider quirks handled** — Streamed tool calls from LM Studio, Kimi and MiniMax no longer split into broken calls. Gemini safety blocks now show as a content-policy error and move on to the fallback model. Text-only vLLM servers that reject images recover, and byte-cap 400s trigger compression. On Bedrock, a hung call fails after one read timeout instead of five. ([#140485](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/140485), [#85031](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/85031), [#85005](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/85005), [#85126](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/85126), [#146314](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/146314) — @Chukwuebuka-2003)
- **Local runtime on llama.cpp b11671** — Adds one-slot DFlash drafts and opt-in Nemotron 3.5 Bolt. ([#139703](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139703) — @jquesnelle)

### Agent Loop & Sessions
- **Lower prompt-token and cache costs** — Every fire of the same cron job now shares one prompt-cache key. Background one-shot calls (summaries, titles, `/moa`) stop paying for cache writes. One-shot runs send 1,570 fewer prompt tokens per call, and four tool schemas are 319 tokens shorter. Gateway goal and heartbeat turns, post-compaction turns and between-turn MCP refreshes no longer rewrite the cached prefix. ([#139876](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139876), [#140478](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/140478), [#144177](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144177), [#144173](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144173), [#139865](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139865), [#139851](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139851) — @100yenadmin, @jonpol01, @chelsealong, @AdrianBinDC)
- **Opt-in prepared compaction** — With `compression.prepare_ahead: true`, the next summary is written in the background as a session nears the trigger, so compaction no longer pauses the turn while the summary is written. Messages that arrive in the meantime stay in the tail word for word. Off by default. ([#144684](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144684), [#144886](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144886) — @kshitijk4poor)
- **Compaction is more honest and harder to stall** — Summaries list uncertain claims on `UNVERIFIED:` lines, so a guess does not come back as a fact. The main-model fallback uses the main route, `/stop` closes a summary stream, and queued messages and `/steer` survive a context-exhaustion reset. ([#86019](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/86019), [#139872](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139872), [#144825](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144825), [#139783](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139783), [#139923](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139923) — @helix4u, @thehugegatsby)
- **`hermes sessions refresh-prompts`** — Continuing sessions pick up an edited `SOUL.md`, skills or context files on their next turn without `/new`. History is kept and each session takes one cache miss. ([#143581](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143581) — @victor-kyriazakos)
- **Opt-in stream lifetime cap** — `agent.stream_max_lifetime` (off by default) cuts off a stream that never finishes. Timeout errors now name the phase that failed and the setting to raise. ([#80701](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/80701), [#80873](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/80873) — @krzsda)
- **Follow-up questions about a photo still see the photo** — This applies after `--resume`, API-server session continuation and gateway restarts. ([#139873](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139873) — @Alexbob0)
- **Session storage** — Auto-prune is opt-in again, and Hermes asks once when the disk runs low. `hermes sessions optimize-storage` shows progress and finished a real store about 18x faster. Startup no longer waits on the scratch prune, and `hermes sessions` failures exit 1. ([#139762](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139762), [#144630](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144630), [#144625](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144625), [#144767](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144767))

### Messaging Platforms (Gateway)
- **One gateway now owns every local session** — Since v0.22.0, the classic CLI, TUI, Desktop, API, ACP editors, bots and cron all run their sessions through one gateway. This cycle fixed what that broke: slash commands, `/retry`, `/refine`, `/review`, clarify cards, reasoning display, usage and ACP sessions work again, and config changes reach resumed sessions. ([#139149](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139149), [#139577](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139577), [#139884](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139884), [#140249](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/140249), [#140595](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/140595), [#141916](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/141916), [#144005](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144005), [#138719](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/138719) — @unsupportedpastels, @yoniebans, @drzxk, @fangliquanflq)
- **Gateway memory and responsiveness** — The roughly once-a-minute freeze during memory trims is gone, closed sessions leave memory, glibc malloc arenas are capped at 4, and measured event-loop blockers moved off the loop. ([#147840](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147840), [#147831](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147831), [#147810](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147810), [#144911](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144911), [#137156](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/137156) — @kouyichi, @ygd58, @zwmaupin, @kshitijk4poor)
- **Safer gateway lifecycle** — `hermes gateway stop`/`restart` refuse while sessions are live and never act on another home's service. A gateway started from an agent's terminal no longer mistakes itself for the launchd service, and when every platform fails at start the gateway stays up degraded. ([#142041](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142041), [#145930](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145930), [#144592](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144592), [#140922](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/140922) — @salch-cred)
- **Bot Mode Group Chats** — Cron jobs can post into a room (`deliver: room:<id>@<profile>`), waking only the bots they @mention. Rooms get a purpose and shared notes, and two opt-in modes pick who answers a message that names nobody (a lead bot, or `auto` routing). `message_agent` wakes the asker once with every reply. ([#144833](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144833), [#148417](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148417), [#148888](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148888), [#144789](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144789) — @rorsch, @OutThisLife)
- **Bot-to-bot loops end** — Bots never receive runtime notices, and an exchange is capped at `max_hops` (default 4) after the last human message. `hermes peer dm <peer>/hermes` reaches the peer's default bot. ([#148903](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148903), [#144900](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144900) — @KoNit-K)
- **Telegram** — New opt-in `dm_topic_auto_transfer` opens a fresh topic for root-DM messages. A new topic's first message lands in it, video notes reach the agent, and group messages not addressed to the bot can stay silent. ([#141347](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/141347), [#141751](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/141751), [#147572](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147572), [#147144](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147144) — @KoNit-K, @PRELVAS94, @sharpnotebot, @Horizont367, @diegoasanch)
- **Slack, Feishu, Discord** — Slack thread context includes emoji reactions, and a new opt-in `thread_followup_silence` covers unaddressed thread replies. Feishu gets clarify cards and a choice picker you tap. Discord honours longer approval timeouts and sends plain audio as an attachment. Rooms can opt into intentional silence. ([#80882](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/80882), [#139586](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139586), [#82170](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/82170), [#145948](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145948), [#143800](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143800), [#147143](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147143) — @hackartists, @helix4u, @liuhao1024, @nicodoggie)
- **Every messaging adapter is now a plugin** — Signal, Weixin, BlueBubbles, QQ Bot, Yuanbao and WhatsApp Cloud now ship as bundled platform plugins. Nothing changes for users. ([#139843](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139843), [#140168](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/140168) — @karljohannisson, @sprmn24)
- **Streamed replies deliver images** — Markdown images in a streamed reply arrive as pictures, and tool-progress arguments render in code blocks. ([#144041](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144041), [#139759](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139759) — @686f6c61, @sambouli)

### Tools, Browser & Terminal
- **`patch` and `write_file` return in milliseconds with LSP on** — A clean TypeScript edit went from 10.1 s to about 0.06 s. Type errors still reach the model. ([#140387](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/140387))
- **Smarter background processes** — A command ending in a lone `&` runs as a tracked background process instead of being refused. Instead of polling a quiet process, the agent is notified when it exits. Jobs that finish during a busy turn come back as one turn. ([#140317](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/140317), [#140330](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/140330), [#147678](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147678) — @lucasfdale, @suhanrain)
- **Password managers in `browser_vault`** — Bundled or verified/official catalog plugins can add their own logins through `ctx.register_login_backend`, and each one can touch only its own entries. The vault key can move into the OS keychain (opt-in `vault.key_storage: keychain`). Saved passwords fill on Camofox pages. ([#143964](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143964), [#144246](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144246), [#146240](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/146240), [#139203](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139203) — @Jesssullivan, @WillPlatnick)
- **Media generation** — Krea 3 image generation and editing through the Nous gateway or the Krea API, and the default image model for paid subscribers who have not picked one. Wan 2.7 video on FAL. The agent can search and pick ElevenLabs voices in `text_to_speech`. ([#142155](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142155), [#87464](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/87464), [#144633](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144633) — @entropidelic)
- **Terminal backends** — Sandboxing backends can set `uses_host_filesystem = False` so the file tools run inside the sandbox, and plugin backends can set their start directory. Singularity moved to its plugin. Command output no longer vanishes once a process has more than 1024 open file descriptors. ([#143756](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143756), [#142225](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142225), [#142561](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142561), [#142299](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142299) — @unsupportedpastels, @aholten, @MohamadKanso)
- **Browser reliability** — The real-profile setting keeps working when Chrome locks the profile. Nested page data no longer crashes the tools, and hidden-tab screenshots no longer hang. ([#139245](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139245), [#140562](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/140562), [#146082](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/146082) — @cmaldonado80)

### Cron, Delegation & Multi-Agent
- **Pluggable delegation backends** — `delegation.backend` chooses how each `delegate_task` task becomes a child run, and the default strategy is now a bundled plugin. The official `advanced-delegation` plugin adds model-map and per-profile routing. `/delegation <mode>` saves for the next session, and `--now` applies it immediately. An opt-in `delegation.prefix_stagger_seconds` lets batch subagents reuse the prompt cache. ([#142563](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142563), [#142564](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142564), [#143423](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143423), [#86553](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/86553))
- **Stop a running cron job** — `hermes cron cancel`, a Desktop Stop button, the API and `cronjob_manage` stop a live run, and deleting a job cancels it. Each job picks its own missed-run policy (`--catch-up on|off`). A manual run no longer consumes a one-shot, and prompts carry the fire time. ([#144801](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144801), [#146113](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/146113), [#82826](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/82826) — @kokhlo, @fangliquanflq, @LeonSGP43)
- **Background subagents survive and report back** — Stopping a turn no longer kills background subagents like `/review`. `/bg` and routed chats wait for their delegations, and completions that were lost are offered again from the ledger. ([#144759](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144759), [#147745](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147745), [#147753](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147753), [#147748](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147748) — @professorpalmer, @nateEc, @rungmc357)
- **Kanban workers are usable again** — `delegate_task` and `session_search` work inside cards, dead attempts free their slot, a worker whose socket drops resumes the same attempt, and worker turns are no longer saved as your memories. ([#141944](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/141944), [#141906](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/141906), [#145954](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145954), [#144861](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144861) — @tmaarcxs, @nonkun12, @calvinnwq)

### Security & Reliability
- **More secret shapes are masked** — Quoted secrets, connection strings, glued and flag-passed secrets, Azure keys, non-PEM private keys and SMB passwords are now masked, and JSON pages are no longer mangled. ([#149435](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/149435), [#148862](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148862), [#149470](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/149470) — @r266-tech, @liuhao1024, @mtp-44, @arbianshkodra, @Baophan00)
- **Approval gate catches more** — The gate now prompts for `curl … | sudo bash` pipes, later or abbreviated PowerShell deletes, and credential uploads hidden behind an approved rule. A stale approval card can no longer approve the next request. ([#87362](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/87362), [#148865](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148865), [#141377](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/141377), [#87554](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/87554) — @Baophan00, @liuhao1024, @VaughnValle)
- **Network boundaries** — URLs whose host parses differently across clients are refused, and without a token A2A refuses requests from browsers and from foreign `Host` headers. ([#145578](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145578), [#145310](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145310) — @unsupportedpastels)
- **Shell-hook consent** — An unattended gateway skips an unapproved hook instead of freezing. A recorded consent takes effect within about 30 seconds. ([#140984](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/140984), [#141034](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/141034) — @arcabotai, @WYSTAF, @liuhao1024)

## 🖥️ Desktop, Webapp, CLI & Install

### Desktop App
- **Every registered gateway stays connected** — Switching between This device, an SSH host or a URL gateway is now instant, with no confirm dialog and no blanked session list. Every gateway's sessions stay visible in the sidebar, and pins stay with the gateway that owns them. An SSH gateway runs one remote backend for all of its profiles, so every SSH profile is listed at launch and switching takes well under a second. ([#147681](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147681), [#147735](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147735), [#147741](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147741), [#147957](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147957), [#147711](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147711) — @dskwe, @Bridgerz, @kenpritchard, @kshitijk4poor)

"New terminal on…" opens a shell on This device or any SSH gateway, side by side. Desktop can also connect to Windows SSH hosts. ([#147708](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147708), [#143898](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143898) — @janviernine, @addelh, @yoniebans)

- **Delegation settings in the app** — Settings → Model → Subagents now uses provider and model dropdowns instead of free-text boxes. ([#141312](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/141312), [#143126](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143126) — @abundantbeing, @e-macgregor, @SecBySagar)
- **Redesigned Capabilities catalog** — Skills and Plugins are browsed as card shelves ordered by tier (Official, Verified, Community). ([#138820](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/138820), [#142708](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142708) — @austinpickett)
- **Plugin SDK: file access and Kanban badges** — The new `ctx.files` lets a Desktop plugin read and write its own data folder and any folder you grant through the app's picker, and nothing else. A Kanban card badge slot lets plugins label cards without touching the board's markup. ([#143688](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143688), [#143673](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143673))

It shows the real exception instead of "Something went wrong". A `clarify` with several questions is now one form with one submit. ([#146776](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/146776), [#146803](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/146803), [#144392](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144392), [#146881](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/146881) — @kshitijk4poor)
- **Workflow conveniences** — You can drag sessions to pin or unpin them, pin Kanban boards as quick-switch tabs, open Bot Chats in new tabs, and compact a conversation from the context panel. `/loop` shows a live countdown, and `/usage` shows provider limits before the first message. ([#142672](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142672), [#148179](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148179), [#143129](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143129), [#148871](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148871), [#139187](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139187), [#141047](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/141047) — @austinpickett, @unsupportedpastels, @kvarnelis, @jerrygooch, @aydnOktay)

- **Messages and replies you can trust** — A message sent just before closing the window is no longer lost, and drafts survive clock jumps and downgrades. Replies are drawn once across reconnects, reloads and stopped turns. Healthy connections are no longer dropped on focus or wake. Old phone-app chats can be continued instead of opening read-only. ([#145018](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145018), [#145528](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145528), [#144899](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144899), [#146843](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/146843), [#147802](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147802))
- **Language packs actually apply** — Korean and other pack-only languages now load on a cold gateway, and the picker hides languages the app cannot show. ([#147515](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147515) — @kshitijk4poor)

### Webapp & Hermes Cloud
- **The Webapp: Desktop in a browser tab, served by your gateway** — With `webapp.enabled: true`, the gateway serves the Desktop workspace on its own listener. `hermes webapp` opens it, and Desktop's Settings → Web Access serves it on your network or a public URL behind sign-in. It is **off by default**. The Webapp is single-user: a signed-in tab acts as you, so its sessions and Group Chats are the same ones native Desktop shows, and display settings follow you across devices on the same machine. ([#141864](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/141864), [#145598](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145598), [#145536](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145536), [#148408](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148408) — @jquesnelle, @BearHuddleston, @IAvecilla)

([#145072](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145072), [#145853](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145853), [#146178](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/146178) — @Adolanium, @DECRUX9812)

([#146882](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/146882), [#145569](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145569), [#145788](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145788), [#144741](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144741) — @Sn0wfly, @unsupportedpastels)

([#144721](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144721), [#145573](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145573), [#145931](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145931), [#146636](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/146636) — @unsupportedpastels, @dokterdok, @Froraut)

### CLI & TUI
- **One gateway owns every local session** — The classic CLI, TUI, Desktop, API server, ACP, bots and cron now attach to each profile's single gateway instead of running their own agents against the same database. A chat is one conversation with one queue and one writer. Follow-ups route classic CLI commands (`/model`, `/cron`, `/queue`, `/save`, `/snapshot`, `/resume`, todos) through it. ### Install, Update & Packaging
- **New installs start on stable** — `install.sh`, `install.ps1` and Hermes-Setup now check out the latest stable release instead of the tip of `main`. ([#139311](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139311))
- **Desktop updates are faster and say more** — An update skips the Desktop rebuild when no desktop input changed, and the update window names its current stage. The dialog shows real release notes. A failed update shows the updater's output and offers a one-click diagnostics upload. Large `state.db` files, comma locales and the system proxy no longer break updates. ([#144922](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144922), [#138483](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/138483), [#148355](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148355), [#144894](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144894) — @KoNit-K, @chenleshu)
- **`hermes update` got much more reliable** — It no longer stashes untracked folders it never touches, and it asks before stashing anything. It reclaims git locks left by a killed update and no longer hangs on an in-flight kanban card. It also names a CDN firewall block instead of a bare 403. ([#147632](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147632), [#147954](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147954), [#147958](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147958), [#140023](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/140023), [#138420](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/138420), [#144507](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144507))
- **Electron 44** — Desktop moves from Electron 40 to 44. This **ends Desktop support on macOS 11, macOS 12 and 32-bit Windows**. ([#142727](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142727) — @ethernet8023, @OutThisLife, @ahrazzle)
- **Webapp ships in Docker and Nix; Docker sandboxes give files back** — The Docker image and the Nix package now ship the Webapp bundle. The image adds tmux and Office/PDF libraries. Files a root Docker sandbox writes are handed back to your user, and setuid bits and file capabilities are stripped from them. ([#145153](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145153), [#145521](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145521), [#146111](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/146111), [#141033](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/141033), [#141086](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/141086) — @IAvecilla, @unsupportedpastels)
- **Package manager** — `hermes pm install --without EXTRA` drops a carried extra and keeps it dropped. A corrupt cached package no longer blocks every install, and `pm update` can skip a lagging target. Plugin dependency edge cases no longer fail the update lock. ([#148194](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148194), [#146929](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/146929), [#142657](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142657), [#148199](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148199), [#148205](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148205) — @benbarclay, @ethernet8023, @hteo1337)

### Infrastructure & CI
- **Release pipeline** — The Microsoft Store build now certifies before the release gate and goes live automatically at publication. Stable runs dispatch from the default branch so caches restore, and macOS notarization keeps going through dropped connections. ([#141725](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/141725), [#148716](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148716), [#138159](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/138159), [#148497](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148497) — @ethernet8023, @unsupportedpastels, @BearHuddleston)

## 🧩 Plugins, Skills & MCP

### Plugins
- **Plugins keep themselves up to date** — `hermes plugins update` with no name lists every installed plugin that has an update, asks once and updates them all (`--yes` for scripts). An Update all action and an Auto-update switch (`plugins.auto_apply`, off by default) now exist in the CLI and TUI (`/plugins update`, `/plugins auto-update`), Desktop and the web dashboard. Catalog installs now update too, and `hermes update` tells you when the new catalog has updates for them. An update whose scan comes back as caution shows you the findings and lets you go ahead (`--force` in the CLI, a dialog in Desktop). ([#141513](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/141513), [#85794](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/85794), [#141894](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/141894) — @alt-glitch)
- **Updates no longer break your setup** — when `hermes update` has to turn a plugin off, it keeps your memory provider, turns the plugin back on once it fits again, and every surface shows it as off. Plugins whose dependencies have no wheels for an OS you don't run (mnemosyne, torch) no longer get disabled on every update. A plugin listed as both enabled and disabled is now reported by the loader and `hermes doctor`. ([#144257](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144257), [#144220](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144220), [#144394](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144394) — @charan-rathore, @YS-OH-CORE, @renleding, @liuhao1024)
- **Catalog version floors are enforced** — an entry's `requires_hermes` now blocks installs on a Hermes that is too old, and `update` won't move a plugin to a pin that needs a newer release. Plugins that use a manifest key from a newer Hermes install with a warning instead of failing. ([#143468](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143468), [#139225](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139225))
- **New Verified tier in the catalog** — Nous gives this tier to plugins made by the company whose product they integrate. Cua Spaces, NVIDIA App, NVIDIA Broadcast, TinyFish and CoreWeave Inference are the first. Plugin pages now put disclosures in their own section at the bottom, and cards show what the plugin does. ([#139983](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139983), [#142165](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142165), [#141742](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/141742), [#142184](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142184))
- **More features leave core for official plugins** — Camofox, `hermes mcp serve` (now `hermes mcp-serve`, with a new `--tools` mode), `hermes import-agent` (adds Cursor, Grok Bot and OpenBot importers) and the Singularity/Apptainer backend all move to plugins. Homes that use Camofox, Singularity or `import-agent` get the plugin installed automatically; MCP clients have to change their args to `mcp-serve`. ([#143484](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143484), [#142545](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142545), [#142538](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142538), [#147799](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147799), [#142536](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142536))
- **New official plugins** — REA (reverse engineering), X Chat (encrypted X DMs as a gateway platform), Meshy (3D generation), ElevenLabs Sound Effects, ElevenLabs Music (songs, lyrics, stems, video scores), advanced-delegation, and bubblewrap (a Linux sandbox for terminal and code commands). Hermes Labs adds `hermes inbox`, `hermes record` (workflow recording that masks passwords) and Patsnap patent search. ([#138225](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/138225), [#139725](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139725), [#142619](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142619), [#143744](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143744), [#146294](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/146294), [#143265](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143265), [#142548](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142548), [#142523](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142523), [#142519](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142519), [#85138](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/85138))
- **New plugin APIs** — plugins can now post a message to the current chat and edit it in place (`ctx.post_message`), ask the session's own agent a question after a turn (`ctx.side_question`, which needs your consent), block a turn before it reaches the model (`pre_llm_call` block), and hold back streaming until a rewrite hook has run (`hold_stream`). New hooks: `post_compaction` and `on_session_delete`. Slash commands now receive the calling session, and platform plugins and plugin skill lookups get public helpers. ([#141005](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/141005), [#143791](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143791), [#81434](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/81434), [#144266](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144266), [#141017](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/141017), [#140995](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/140995), [#140997](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/140997), [#140624](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/140624), [#140978](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/140978) — @curiouscleo, @Halldrix, @Baophan00, @Finn763, @pieralukasz, @ewtillman, @nekwo)
- **Plugins can sign you in to third-party APIs without seeing the token** — a plugin declares an OAuth client, `hermes auth add <plugin>:<id>` runs the browser sign-in, and Hermes attaches the token only on requests to the hosts the plugin declared. ([#141510](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/141510) — @bablobanov)
- **Bigger Desktop plugin SDK** — Desktop plugins can add rows to the composer's right-click menu and words to the spell checker, render media from their own tools, post cards into their own chat, and script the preview Browser once they declare the capability and you allow it for that site. Portable plugins get a Settings ▸ Plugins form, and a newly saved API key reaches their MCP server without a restart. ([#143678](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143678), [#143980](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143980), [#143776](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143776), [#143668](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143668), [#141533](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/141533) — @Schildkrote)
- **Plugins behave the same on a shared gateway** — classic CLI plugin commands and `pre_command` now run in the gateway with the rest of the plugin, and disabling a plugin also closes its websockets. A secondary profile's dashboard plugins run in that profile's own plugin host. ([#139575](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139575), [#139691](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139691), [#139569](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139569), [#139689](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139689) — @unsupportedpastels, @dokterdok)
- **Remote config backend for fleets (opt-in)** — a fleet agent such as one on Hermes Cloud can load each profile's `config.yaml` from a central service, and admins can lock keys. It only turns on when `HERMES_CONFIG_BACKEND=remote` is set. ([#122509](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/122509) — @benbarclay)
- **Faster startup** — from a git checkout every `hermes` command starts about 1 s faster, because provider plugins and the restart check no longer run git each time (15 git calls down to 2). ([#144640](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144640) — @100yenadmin)

### Skills
- **Lock a skill** — after `hermes curator lock <skill>`, the agent can't change that skill with `skill_manage`, file edits or terminal writes, even under `--yolo`, and the curator won't archive it. ([#147557](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/147557) — @daviseford)
- **Leaner built-in skills** — a fresh install ships 44 built-in skills instead of 58. Word, PowerPoint and Excel merge into one `microsoft-office` skill, 12 niche skills become optional installs, and optional skills that vendor repos, catalog MCPs or the built-in web search now cover are removed. The vendor repos for W&B, Qdrant, Pinecone, Notion, Airtable and Shopify are now trusted taps in `hermes skills browse`. The skills index in the prompt is shorter too. ([#146333](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/146333), [#148639](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148639), [#144174](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144174) — @soyluisarca)
- **Skills survive compaction and load by plugin name** — every skill that compaction removes, small or slash-loaded, now leaves a reload marker. Plugin skills are named after their plugin (`blender:blender`) and load even when the model adds `plugin:` in front. ([#138428](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/138428), [#143822](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143822), [#143784](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143784) — @100yenadmin)
- **unbroker handles spam calls** — the optional unbroker skill can now start from a phone number and register it on the US Do Not Call list. ([#145118](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145118) — @SHL0MS)

### MCP
- **Tool costs and per-chat spend limits** — MCP servers, from plugin packages or `config.yaml`, can declare what each tool costs and a spend limit per chat. The approval prompt shows the cost and the chat's running total, and a call that would go over the limit asks first, even on a trusted server or in YOLO mode. ([#142470](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142470), [#143787](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143787))
- **Clearer approvals for untrusted servers** — choosing Allow for this session or Always now actually stops the next prompt for that tool, prompts show the call's arguments with secrets masked, and YOLO or `approvals.mode: off` skips them. ([#143780](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143780), [#143795](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143795), [#143787](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143787) — @liuhao1024, @fangliquanflq)
- **Live progress for long MCP calls** — when a server reports progress, the Desktop tool row and the CLI spinner show the percentage and message, and plugins get a `tool.progress` event. Servers that declare a longer deadline are no longer cut off by the generic tool timeout. ([#141985](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/141985), [#138491](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/138491))
- **MCP events over webhooks (experimental, opt-in)** — a server with `mcp_servers.<name>.events: true` can notify Hermes when something happens upstream, and each event starts an agent run through the gateway's webhook listener. ([#140121](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/140121) — @Potrock)
- **Connections** — servers now see `hermes-agent/<version>` as the client name, results and tool lists over 1 MiB work on Streamable HTTP, and Otter.ai OAuth logins complete. The MCP catalog adds RentAHuman. ([#106395](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/106395), [#143803](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143803), [#148635](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148635), [#142246](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/142246) — @yulunz, @khanaleem727-eng, @liuhao1024, @AlexanderLiteplo)

- Ctrl+D mid-turn in the classic CLI detaches instead of interrupting the turn. ([#140489](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/140489))
- Stdio MCP servers on a multi-profile gateway use their own profile's home, not the default ([#148129](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148129) — @bluemogul1914)
- Plugin-rewritten messages no longer refused on multi-profile gateways ([#139076](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/139076))
- Plugin MCP `${VAR}` header auth survives reconnects; unset optional vars aren't passed literally ([#148879](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148879), [#141379](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/141379))
- `hermes plugins doctor` no longer copies a plugin into itself until the disk fills ([#146836](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/146836), [#146761](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/146761) — @gyeyeop, @xxxigm)
- Windows: Desktop plugin names can't escape the plugins folder ([#146394](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/146394))
- Host-isolated plugins keep provider types, so secret sources apply ([#144430](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/144430))
- Enabling new deps on a running gateway says restart instead of claiming a reload ([#143404](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/143404) — @benbarclay)
- Desktop/Webapp install the backend half of manifest-only plugins ([#146001](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/146001) — @m0nty81)
- ClawHub skills show as installed after install ([#145210](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/145210) — @austinpickett)
- No more health-check warnings for closed local MCP apps ([#148395](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/148395))

name: v0.9.19
body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.19

Released on 2026-11-06.

A render now matches preview when a `set` interrupts a running tween, so it no longer comes out blank. `cloud render` also keeps going when a project uses a font with no file on this computer. It falls back to the next font in the stack, as a local render does, and names the missing font.

## Fixes

- **CLI:** A font missing from this computer no longer stops a cloud render, and is named ([b56e2c036](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b56e2c03669cc0515209b0f886594b36867eab02), [#7287](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7287)).
- **Core:** A render lands where preview does when a set interrupts a tween ([6abc62a17](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6abc62a1796f7ebafd001dd13869a049f1f87dc5), [#7283](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7283)).

## Full changelog

https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/compare/v0.9.18...v0.9.19

name: v0.9.18
body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.18

Released on 2026-11-05.

A render on a busy Windows PC no longer stalls behind its own lint. Under heavy CPU load in our test, the wait before the browser check fell from over 30 seconds to about 3. `check` also stops piling up GPU memory on graded images, and `normalize-audio` now reports the level a held clip actually stays at.

## Fixes

- **CLI:** A render's lint runs at normal priority, so a busy Windows PC no longer stalls it ([72326a3ac](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/72326a3ac7abb650b7bb4bbd33b2b855bc790cac), [#7268](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7268)).
- **CLI:** Normalize-audio says where the target stays when a limit holds its gain ([4935d6736](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4935d6736b64ed3dd68524c1cb2c7f011171baef), [#7267](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7267)).
- **Core:** Check's no-draw seeks no longer upload graded images to the GPU ([256b84a41](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/256b84a41bc32913870953c06e05f4ab25e963f8), [#7264](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7264)).

## Full changelog

https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/compare/v0.9.17...v0.9.18

name: v0.9.17
body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.17

Released on 2026-11-05.

Set `HF_VIDEO_FRAME_WINDOW=true` with segmented capture and a long render holds far less on disk. Each segment extracts only the frames it shows, then deletes them. Segmented capture also checks drawElement frames against their reference samples now, and `check --budget` stops a whole check in time.

## Features

- **Producer:** Render long videos with windowed source frames behind a flag ([968f97fe9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/968f97fe954f733d8610ab86a09ded1e78fec23c), [#7242](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7242)).
- **Producer:** A capture segment extracts the frames it shows and deletes them ([599eaad2b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/599eaad2ba6a908b6da9de724bc04474c79fa019), [#7241](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7241)).
- **CLI:** Check --budget stops the whole check in time and reports what it found ([b7d72c947](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b7d72c9478bf0717458ced2d8ab35b5807b45f3c), [#7245](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7245)).
- **CLI:** Info --media lists every clip the render hears, on the film's clock ([df54f380c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/df54f380cbcada23c56019972441b98160f2adb8), [#7235](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7235)).

## Fixes

- **CLI:** Check judges SVG gradient text by its gradient stops, not as black ([478ef2f26](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/478ef2f26e8b2811383d6e0e31b69efebf508148), [#7258](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7258)).
- **Engine:** Name a failed script's origin and error before the free text of its warning ([7290ee68c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7290ee68c3e1607b8cead5bb8394e39c679204c3), [#7256](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7256)).
- **CLI:** Normalize-audio --reference stops short of the peak ceiling instead of refusing ([2f2195515](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2f2195515b6cb693909ddd46e6c6ced43965e287), [#7254](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7254)).
- **Producer:** Segmented and sequential capture check drawElement samples ([8df4f21c2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8df4f21c20679fc92ae338ad647da5f5d9a69d76), [#7255](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7255)).
- **Core:** Two scenes drawing SVGs with the same ids each show their own ([b108f8512](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b108f851201dc22f5d4974ee7f1c9d19b472cc1e), [#7251](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7251)).
- **CLI:** End a stalled cloud upload and send it again ([f98218a22](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f98218a224ba5b3ad0591485d9b1b9344ba0ce11), [#7237](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7237)).
- **Core:** Decode WebKit sources by memory budget, not by length ([600bfa451](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/600bfa451bd69a6101666f46d03a22e970af972b), [#7232](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7232)).
- **Core:** Snapshot and preview show a clip on the frame render shows it ([5377b756b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5377b756b5d1fcf06171a133b715003f05ff71c7), [#7238](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7238)).
- **Producer:** An export over the peak ceiling loses only what it must ([d40d0b251](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d40d0b251f6dc5d97dff472cc99d528a46cab9db), [#7246](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7246)).
- **Lint:** Every selector in a comma list counts as hidden by authored CSS ([a664f99ec](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a664f99ec86162411e726bb5ae7fb0cc250b819e), [#7252](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7252)).
- **Core:** The bundle's contract check reads a timeline registered in a local script ([0b3559824](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0b355982460e0ca66b6f762da7732d4990c6ddc1), [#7248](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7248)).
- **CLI:** Check sees an SVG stroke drawing on, so it no longer calls it a dead stretch ([644b166e7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/644b166e78c40fa527715cb843adf1c0ddf9182c), [#7250](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7250)).
- **CLI:** An unknown command answers in a few lines and says what to run instead ([0a6746e1d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0a6746e1d6fabab6178ef8ead0e6da1593a1e59a), [#7247](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7247)).
- **CLI:** Lint says nothing when the OS refuses to lower its priority ([c1977fab3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c1977fab3e632aa559636ab28bdedd764fdb7dc6), [#7244](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7244)).
- **Lint:** Compositions in .hyperframesignore no longer count as the project's ([80e02e74a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/80e02e74a0af8bc6be30cb4c671b03b064c667b6), [#7239](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7239)).
- **CLI:** Name the network cause of a failed fetch in the error box ([f55990ebc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f55990ebca68780a680af4080df88e114537739c), [#7236](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7236)).
- **Core:** Hlg footage tone-maps to sdr at the bt.2408 reference white ([5ee9e928d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5ee9e928d5d1377826dd025a73bb5ec22666bcee), [#7234](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7234)).

## Internal

- **Producer:** Deferred frame extraction moves out of the distributed code ([35cbca992](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/35cbca99274907c914e4e083f30684060e3b4c58), [#7240](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7240)).

name: 0.11.1-nightly.b35b96a
body:
Nightly release from commit: b35b96ad065aea26aafb73eac69fd4866f173b76

npm packages, rust crates and python wheels are available under this version 0.11.1-nightly.b35b96a

## Neovim Plugin
- `{target}.so` / `.dylib` / `.dll` - Lua module for Neovim

## C FFI Library (for Bun/Node/Python)
- `c-lib-{target}.so` / `.dylib` / `.dll` - C FFI library
- `fff-c-{target}.tar.gz` (or `.zip` for Windows) - C SDK bundle (.a static lib, .h header, .pc pkg-config)

## MCP Server
- `fff-mcp-{target}` - MCP server binary

## Python Package
- `python/*.whl` / `python/*.tar.gz` - Python wheels and sdist
- Install from PyPI: `pip install fff-search` (when published)

Update mcp via:
```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dmtrKovalenko/fff/main/install-mcp.sh | bash
```
