name: v18.17.0
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

### Added

- Added `Agent.queuedMessageGate` to filter queued messages before delivery and observe claimed messages returned undelivered.
- Added `wireToolsFingerprint()`, returning a hash of the tool specs sent with a request.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Added

- Added opt-in standard Responses WebSockets for catalog-supported models, with incremental turns and automatic HTTP/SSE fallback; enable through OMP settings ([#17354](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17354) by [@TatsukiMeng](https://github.com/TatsukiMeng))
- `AuthStorage` can now be constructed over an `AuthStorageBackend` instead of a credential store, so another thread's instance can serve every call
- Anthropic official-API sessions use message threads, sending only new messages per turn for faster first tokens; toggle with `statefulResponses: false` or `PI_ANTHROPIC_MESSAGE_THREADS=0`/`1`
- Added `devin-cli` (Devin CLI seat key) and `devin-windsurf` (Windsurf Enterprise sign-in) logins, both stored as a `devin` API key ([#13637](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/13637) by [@pavel-kalmykov](https://github.com/pavel-kalmykov), [#13288](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/13288) by [@pavel-kalmykov](https://github.com/pavel-kalmykov))
- Factory Droid Gemini 4 Argon requests now match Droid's request and conversation handling ([#17861](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17861) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Changed

- Changing the Codex ultrafast service tier now opens a connection for the selected tier, so requests route correctly
- Factory Droid requests and login now match the current Droid client
- Codex HTTP requests (turns, compaction, image generation, web search, model discovery) no longer send `OpenAI-Beta: responses=experimental`, matching the official Codex client

### Fixed

- Fixed account switching stopping at rate-limited accounts; other eligible stored accounts are now tried first
- Fixed OpenRouter Decisions judges ignoring `compat.openRouterRouting` and `compat.extraBody`, including `@provider` pins ([#18140](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18140))
- OAuth broker now validates residency, inference-region, and selected-organization metadata in uploaded credentials and remote snapshots
- Fixed Muse Code subscription sessions failing with `403 client_attestation_denied` when tools were available ([#17435](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17435), [#17515](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17515) by [@harshav167](https://github.com/harshav167), continued in [#18053](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18053) by [@abilliontokens](https://github.com/abilliontokens))
- Fixed `xai-tts` failing with `422 missing field language`; `language` now defaults to `auto` ([#17992](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17992) by [@Mirceone](https://github.com/Mirceone))
- Fixed Codex WebSocket turns sending malformed incremental input after reconnects or `onPayload` edits, and prewarming busy sockets ([#17809](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17809) by [@xiangnan0811](https://github.com/xiangnan0811))
- API-key logins now store keys under the auth rule's `store-as` provider ([#13637](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/13637) by [@pavel-kalmykov](https://github.com/pavel-kalmykov))
- Fixed `openai-responses`, Codex, and Muse Code continuations after an output limit cut a tool call, including reasoning-first models ([#17847](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17847), [#18189](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18189) by [@mttzzz](https://github.com/mttzzz))
- Gemini and Vertex malformed-response finishes now report the correct stop reason and keep token usage; RPC prompt errors are reported as retryable
- Fixed reranking when Cohere-compatible responses omit the model field
- Reranking requests now send configured model headers, including custom `Authorization`
- Provider retries no longer retry responses explicitly marked non-retryable

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Added

- Added `tool-name-prefix` compat axis for Responses hosts that reject certain tool names; Muse Code sets it to `_` ([#17435](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17435), [#17515](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17515) by [@harshav167](https://github.com/harshav167), continued in [#18053](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18053) by [@abilliontokens](https://github.com/abilliontokens))
- Added `supports-message-threads` compat axis (`supportsMessageThreads`), enabled for Claude 4.5+ on first-party Anthropic
- Added opt-in Responses WebSocket capability via OMP settings or SDK preferences, off by default ([#17354](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17354) by [@TatsukiMeng](https://github.com/TatsukiMeng))
- Added Factory Droid Gemini 4 Argon on Global inference for accounts with the feature flag ([#17861](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17861) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Added Factory Droid Muse Spark 1.3 (Global region, `muse_spark_1_3` flag) with low to xhigh effort ([#17862](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17862) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Changed

- Updated Factory Droid client version reporting; improved tool-input streaming for Claude via Azure Foundry

### Fixed

- Fixed newly published Azure models missing after catalog refresh ([#18173](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18173), [#18174](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18174) by [@dunkpi](https://github.com/dunkpi))
- Fixed Factory Droid hiding models when the live-routing family default yields no usable upstream; explicit empty per-model routes still hide them ([#17862](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17862) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- Bash commands, foreground and background, now show a live execution visualization in Raw or Python-like Pseudo view, with variable values and replay history; disable with `display.shellVisualization` (default on).
- `grep` and `glob` inside an ovnfs checkout ask the ovnfs daemon to search the checkout in-process, avoiding per-file mount round trips; the daemon and its mount come from `ovnfs --json status` when the ovnfs binary is found. They fall back to the native search when the daemon is unavailable or rejects the request, and cancelling the tool cancels the daemon's search. ovnfs with admin protocol 5 is required.
- Added `skills.manualSkills` glob patterns to hide skills from the model catalog while keeping them manually invocable ([#18114](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18114) by [@Shadorain](https://github.com/Shadorain))
- Added Keenable web search (`web/keenable`), using `KEENABLE_API_KEY` or a stored `keenable` credential, or a keyless public endpoint when explicitly selected ([#17953](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17953) by [@KGKallasmaa](https://github.com/KGKallasmaa))
- `web_search` results list failed providers with reason and status code in `details.failures` ([#18124](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18124) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Added opt-in background auto-update (`update.auto`, offered in setup) that installs new releases via your install method and runs them next launch; skipped on Nix, source checkouts, and Tern.
- `omp update` refuses to run while another update (including auto-update) is installing.
- Added `none` to `edit.mode` (and `PI_EDIT_VARIANT`) to remove the `edit` tool; `bash` stays available even if `bash.enabled` is off.
- Added default-off `providers.openaiResponsesWebsockets` to use WebSockets for supported standard Responses models ([#17354](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17354) by [@TatsukiMeng](https://github.com/TatsukiMeng))
- Pinned sessions show a pin beside their title; `/unpin [session id]` unpins a session ([#17848](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17848) by [@SuperUserA](https://github.com/SuperUserA))
- Extensions can draw tool calls and `message`/`event` blocks full, compact, or hidden via `pi.registerTranscriptPresenter()`, and redraw with `ctx.ui.refreshTranscript(ids)`; enable with `extensionRenderers.transcriptPresenters` (default off) ([#17960](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17960) by [@materemias](https://github.com/materemias)) ([#17997](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17997) by [@materemias](https://github.com/materemias))
- Consecutive compact transcript blocks render as tight rows without blank gaps; extension renderers opt in via `isTranscriptBlockCompact()` ([#17997](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17997) by [@materemias](https://github.com/materemias))
- Added a fullscreen link browser for links in scrollback: press Alt+O again (or Page Up) while link tags are shown ([#16476](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16476) by [@materemias](https://github.com/materemias))
- Added a `cache` status-line segment (`full`/`nerd` presets) showing whether the next message hits the prompt cache; Tern and `/session` show why not and how much is resent ([#12677](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/12677)) ([#17496](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17496) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- `^` model tags accept a `:level` suffix (e.g. `^openai-codex/gpt-6-astra:high`) to set the subagent's effort (overriding `task.maxEffort`), with completion of each model's supported levels ([#17574](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17574) by [@a-glapinski](https://github.com/a-glapinski))
- Added the `chillax` magic keyword for brief, lowest-effort thinking on supported models; configure via `magicKeywords.chillax`
- Added `tui.colorfulMarkdown` (on by default): replies color headings by level, bold and italic text, inline code and table headers from the theme's palette; turn it off for the previous single heading color and plain bold/italic
- Added `tui.motion` (`full`/`reduced`/`none`), `tui.spinnerInterval` (`0` = static) and `tui.maxFps` to control animation and repaint rate, also via `--motion`/`--spinner-interval`/`--max-fps` and `PI_MOTION`/`PI_SPINNER_INTERVAL`/`PI_MAX_FPS`; an explicit `tui.spinnerInterval` beats `tui.motion`, and keystroke echo keeps 30 fps ([#14240](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14240) by [@mccraigmccraig](https://github.com/mccraigmccraig))
- Added `omp zsh`, `omp bash` and `omp sh` to run omp's built-in shell engine directly, passing all arguments through and exiting with the shell's status.
- `omp zsh`/`omp bash` keep shell history in your `$HISTFILE`, compatible with real zsh, including `!` expansion, `fc` and `history`.
- `omp zsh` runs interactively like zsh (line editor, `bindkey`, completion, job control, prompt hooks, common modules), so oh-my-zsh and powerlevel10k configs start.
- RPC `bash` results report truncated output via `elidedBytes`/`elidedLines` and `columnTruncated*`/`columnMax` fields, decoded by the Go, Python and Rust SDKs ([#17957](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17957) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Added `pi.getShortcutConflict(chord)` so extensions can check whether a key chord is free or who holds it ([#17961](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17961) by [@materemias](https://github.com/materemias))
- Exported `unwrapHashlineHeaderPath` from `@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent` to turn a `[path#TAG]` target into its plain path ([#17961](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17961) by [@materemias](https://github.com/materemias))
- `devin-cli` login imports Devin CLI credentials, so the `devin` provider no longer requires `DEVIN_API_KEY` ([#13637](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/13637) by [@pavel-kalmykov](https://github.com/pavel-kalmykov))
- `devin-windsurf` login authenticates the `devin` provider with an existing Windsurf Enterprise account ([#13288](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/13288) by [@pavel-kalmykov](https://github.com/pavel-kalmykov))

### Changed

- ovnfs turns on by itself when its binary is found (`ovnfs.path`, else `ovnfs` on PATH): agents get the separate-checkout guidance, and isolated subagents use ovnfs checkouts when `isolation.backend` is `auto`
- Text Verbosity now defaults to low and applies to Codex too, matching the official Codex client: shorter answers that finish sooner; set `textVerbosity` to `medium` for the old length
- A cost cap set on the main thread now applies to running subagents immediately
- RPC wire protocol and task streaming have lower serialization overhead
- Local Whisper speech-to-text, Parakeet/Nemotron speech, and the local tiny model install their runtimes on first use, shrinking installs; first use needs network access
- `wait` with nothing new returns after 5s (backing off to 5m over repeated idle waits) instead of blocking up to 30 minutes, and nudges the agent toward other work
- `wait` returns jobs finishing within 1.5s of each other in one result
- Broadcasts and progress notes no longer cut short `wait` or interrupt bash/eval; a direct message still ends a wait and delivers every queued message
- `wait` for a reply gives up after 5 minutes (was 30) and returns at once if the other agent is waiting on the user
- In Tern, streamed assistant text and thinking are sent unpaced, cutting omp's CPU use; other terminals keep the smooth reveal
- Source-checkout sessions start faster; existing build stamps remain readable
- The agent's `bash` tool never touches your shell history or completion, and its `zsh -i`/`bash -i` skip `.zshrc`/`.bashrc`
- Embedded Bash follows Bash 5.3 semantics and preserves supported aliases
- CLI flags, session-only settings writes, and SDK overrides now outrank a setting's env var (`PI_MOTION=none omp --motion full` uses full motion); env vars still outrank settings files
- JS and Python tool aborts now report the original abort reason
- Many concurrent subagents now run in worker threads so they don't slow the TUI; new `task.workerThreads` caps workers (default 4; `0` keeps all on the main thread)
- Interactive startup reaches the first frame ~75ms sooner when skills are listed in the system prompt
- "What's New" release notes now appear just after the first frame; quitting before it keeps them for the next start
- Subagents can no longer broadcast (`write agent://all` fails, pointing to a direct `agent://<id>` message) and are no longer told to announce shared-file edits; the main agent can still broadcast
- Factory Droid Gemini 4 Argon sessions keep earlier turns intact across save and reload, with correct image clamping ([#17861](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17861) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Fixed

- On macOS, the browser tool's headless Chromium keeps background tabs at normal CPU priority, so on a busy machine `tab.traceStart()`, opening a second tab, and other calls into background tabs no longer stall or time out
- Subagents loading MCP tools (such as Kata's `load_*`) no longer change the main session's tools or system prompt
- Mounting an MCP tool mid-session on prefix-bound models no longer changes the eval tool description, and the mount notice now reaches the model
- Worker-thread subagents are faster: switching views on long transcripts no longer lags, `wait` no longer streams full transcripts, and they stall less on a busy main thread
- Streaming a large batch `task` call no longer slows quadratically (about 80 ms → 2 ms for a 200 KB call)
- `computer` from Eval now uses `zoom` for legible close-ups instead of cropping the downscaled screenshot ([#18158](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18158) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Python eval `@tool` definitions with type annotations now register on Python 3.9 ([#18143](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18143) by [@Winston-Hsiao](https://github.com/Winston-Hsiao))
- `read` of an SEC EDGAR filing document or folder returns that document, not the company profile ([#18150](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18150) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- `read` of a Read the Docs page no longer returns another repository's linked file ([#18162](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18162) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- A browser click beside a direct `tab.waitForDownload()` now errors with a `tab.run` suggestion that actually catches the download ([#17615](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17615)) ([#18155](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18155) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Browser `open({ viewport })` now sizes relay tabs, `app.cdp_url`/`app.path` browsers, and headed Chromium on first open ([#18160](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18160) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Discarded empty, reasoning-only, or length-stop turns still count billed usage in session totals and `omp stats` ([#18178](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18178))
- `/extensions` shows the active `~/.agents` skill when a higher-priority `~/.claude` copy is not opted in ([#18190](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18190))
- Tool results whose `details` contain a throwing getter no longer silently stop all later session saves ([#18134](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18134) by [@MonsieurBarti](https://github.com/MonsieurBarti))
- `write` to a new `ssh://` file no longer fails when the content ends with a `read` truncation notice ([#18154](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18154) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

- The `tts` tool uses Grok Voice again instead of silently falling back to Kokoro, and sends `language` to xAI (auto-detected if omitted) ([#17992](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17992) by [@Mirceone](https://github.com/Mirceone))
- Windows bash output on non-UTF-8 code pages (CJK) no longer turns into mojibake after one invalid byte; the byte shows as `�` ([#17947](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17947) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Hindsight no longer silently drops the last mental model (often `User Preferences`) from the prompt when over the render budget ([#17548](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17548), [#17955](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17955) by [@harshaygadekar](https://github.com/harshaygadekar))
- Subagents woken by IRC, restored, revived, or rerun by a workpool keep their `task.softRequestBudget` guard; it and `task.agentSoftRequestBudget` resolve by agent name (e.g. `scout`), not task ID ([#17988](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17988) by [@sinhduc01](https://github.com/sinhduc01), [#18121](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18121) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))
- A focused subagent's `blocked` indicator follows its own approval mode, tool policies, and grants instead of the main session's

- Bash tool: an `EXIT` trap fires once at the end of its command, not after every later command

- Bash tool: `env -i` no longer passes non-shell-name variables (`A-B=1`), and `X=v env -i`/`X=v env -u X` no longer pass an exported outer `X`
- Bash tool: `xargs` reports a signal-killed command like GNU xargs: `xargs: CMD: terminated by signal N`, stopping with status 125
- macOS: starting a bash tool session no longer briefly sets umask to 022, which could give new files wrong permissions
- Bash tool: a shebang-less executable script run in the background from a FIFO (`./script < fifo &`) runs as bash instead of failing with `Exec format error`

- DeepSeek-style `*** End` and `*** End Patch` markers are no longer written into files or truncate later edits
- Composer prediction ghost text no longer vanishes when advisor messages arrive

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Breaking Changes

- Replaced `parseShell()` with `RunTrace.present()` and `ShellVisualization`.

### Added

- Added `RunTrace`: command states, variable assignments, per-producer output, bounded replay, Raw/Pseudo presentation, and restoring persisted traces.
- Added `obash --trace=PATH` to write a JSON execution trace at exit; `UnitCompiled` events now include source node tables.
- `Shell` and `executeShell` now run pi-shell's Bash engine with Bash 5.3 semantics, including aliases containing pipelines, subshells, and separators.
- Native shell is faster across parsing, functions, expansion, redirections, arithmetic, loops, and external command startup.
- Sixel image output now uses a built-in encoder.
- Built-in `ps -o` accepts Apple's `utime` (alias `putime`) for user CPU time, instead of failing with `unknown output format specifier 'utime'`.
- Shell spawn benchmarks now report median and p99 latency.

### Changed

- Built-in `jq` now reports errors as plain text with `line:column` locations.
- Work-profile flamegraphs are now static SVGs with hoverable titles.
- Built-in `grep -r`, `rg`, `find` and `fd` are faster on small and large trees and stream output to pipes in batches.

### Fixed

- Fixed a crash on Linux when a zsh-mode sort or `strftime`/`$langinfo` named a locale that is not installed.
- Fixed `env -i` in the bash tool passing exported shell functions (`BASH_FUNC_name%%`) and non-environment shell variables to the command.
- Fixed `$!` in command substitutions, subshells and pipeline stages to name the parent's last background job, as in Bash ([#18107](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18107) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed built-in local `rsync` output on a busy machine sometimes differing from rsync 3.5.1: `--delete`/info lines from subdirectories could print after the top-level names and the byte totals in `sent … received …`/`--stats` could be off by 4.
- Fixed Windows `rsync` treating a one-letter daemon host like `h::module` as a drive path ([#18048](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18048) by [@jchanghong023](https://github.com/jchanghong023))
- Fixed git, its helpers and commit hooks started by omp reading the terminal, which could swallow keystrokes and leave Tern protocol text like `_tsp;e;{"ev":"ack",…}` in the composer; they no longer inherit the terminal or share its session.
- Fixed `ssh` started by the built-in `rsync` (and `sort --compress-program`) prompting on the user's terminal, e.g. host-key confirmations appearing after exit; they no longer share omp's terminal or session.
- Fixed history saves hanging when a stale lock cannot be removed.
- Fixed native addon startup on glibc 2.17–2.28, which lacks `posix_spawn_file_actions_addchdir_np` ([#18046](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18046) by [@jchanghong023](https://github.com/jchanghong023))
- Fixed Windows `rmdir` accepting trailing-dot or trailing-space operands that could remove a different directory ([#18047](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18047) by [@jchanghong023](https://github.com/jchanghong023))
- Fixed `timeout`, `nohup`, `git` and similar utilities inside shell functions skipping operands or running the function's arguments ([#18030](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18030) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed native Windows commands not resolving executables via `PATH`/`PATHEXT`, and absolute paths being prefixed with the cwd ([#18041](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18041) by [@jchanghong023](https://github.com/jchanghong023))
- Fixed minimized `git stash pop` and `git status` counting status lines and "Dropped" notices as untracked files ([#18159](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18159) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))
- Fixed associative arrays slowing quadratically: 100,000 inserts and lookups drop from ~90 s to ~0.1 s.
- Fixed GTK3 Open/Save dialogs on Linux: `ax()` and element input work, and Wayland window lists include them ([#18011](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18011) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- `capabilities()` now reports `input: false` and `inputPermission: "unavailable"` on Wayland without a RemoteDesktop portal (e.g. sway); input fails immediately ([#18012](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18012) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed `.bzl` files being treated as Python instead of Starlark in `ast-grep`, `astGrep`, `astEdit`, and code summaries ([#18145](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18145) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))
- Minimized `rustfmt --check` output now reports how many files need formatting instead of miscounting diff locations ([#18147](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18147) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Minimized `git diff`, `git show` and `diff -r` now list binary files (as `Bin`), pure renames and mode-only changes ([#18148](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18148) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed Wayland `el.type` and `el.press(keys)` shifting the app's focus before refusing; they now refuse first ([#17915](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17915) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed Windows background drags in Tk apps reporting success while doing nothing; they now follow `computer.backgroundFallback` ([#17913](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17913) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Built-in `rsync` now matches rsync 3.5.1 for unopenable `--log-file` errors; empty `--log-file=` logs to syslog ([#17980](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17980) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed X11 takeover and `raise()` failing on a window previously targeted by background typing, e.g. under Openbox ([#17910](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17910) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed X11 background keys into Qt 5/6 apps silently doing nothing; they now use takeover, or refuse when `computer.backgroundFallback` is `refuse` ([#17911](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17911) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed Wayland `doubleClick` and `click` with `count` registering as a single click in KDE Plasma Qt apps ([#17903](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17903) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed `press()`, `perform()` and `menu.select()` failing on Linux in browsers, VS Code, LibreOffice and non-English locales; `press()` now toggles toggle/radio buttons ([#17936](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17936) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed `computer.focusedWindow()`, `ax()` and `observe()` on GNOME/KDE Wayland reading a shell surface instead of the focused app ([#17922](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17922) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed takeover keys into iPhone Mirroring and Screen Sharing leaving Fn held, dropping Shift and later letters ([#17909](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17909) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- An unanswered Wayland RemoteDesktop permission dialog now fails input with `Timeout` before the run deadline, sending nothing ([#17932](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17932) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed X11 takeover input stopping with `Cancelled` after you typed locally; Escape now stops computer use for the rest of the turn ([#17912](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17912) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed X11 background `el.type`/`el.press` raising the window and taking your keyboard; elements without GTK 3 focus now use takeover ([#17921](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17921) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Breaking Changes

- `MarkdownTheme.heading` receives the heading depth (1–6) as a second argument; callers must pass it.
- Shell visualization uses the native presentation engine: shell node IDs are opaque strings, and native shell nodes receive presentation data, not raw execution traces.
- Replaced `CustomEditor.modelMentionLabel` with `resolveModelMention` (returns `{ label, selector }`); `collapseModelMentions` takes the same callback; `getModelMentionSuggestions` returns `ModelMentionCompletion`.
- `SetupHost` must implement `autoUpdate`, `canAutoUpdate()` and `saveAutoUpdate()` for setup version 3's auto-update scene.
- Removed `SPINNER_ADVANCE_MS` in favor of the shared spinner clock; `sharedSpinnerFrame` is exported from `spinner-clock`.
- Removed `formatMeta` from `render/render-utils`.
- `TranscriptContainer.nativeBlocks()` and `Composer.describeSurface()` now require the frame's `DescribeContext`.
- `GradientHighlightSpec.lightness` now maps gradient position to lightness like `hue` instead of taking a fixed percentage.

### Added

- Colorful Markdown, on by default (`setMarkdownColorful`): headings by level, bold/italic, inline code and table headers take distinct hues from the theme's `terminal.ansi` palette. `MarkdownTheme` gains optional `strong`, `emphasis` and `tableHeader` roles; `Theme.ansiFg()` paints a palette slot, falling back to the terminal's own palette.
- Bash cards show incremental Python-like pseudocode with a Raw toggle, failure marks and variable values; the inspector adds layers, split source and timestamp replay. Native hosts draw an inline segmented run box (`shell` = command, `omp.tool.bash.output` = output).
- `VersionUpdate`, `WelcomeComponent.setVersionUpdate()` and `ComposerWelcomeUpdate.versionUpdate`: the welcome banner shows background self-update progress, readiness or failure.
- `newSessionThinkingLevel` / `resolveConfiguredThinkingLevel` resolve a new session's starting thinking level; `ComposerCache.writeStatus` accepts `{ shared: false }` to keep a project's status out of the any-project fallback.
- `SettingItem.menu` exposes a cycling row's choices as a menu opened by `SettingsList.openSubmenuFor`; Enter/Space still cycle.
- `StatusLineComponent.setSessionPinned()` / `setPinnedSessionIds()` / `isSessionPinned()` track pinned sessions; `session_name` shows the theme's pin icon for them ([#17848](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17848) by [@SuperUserA](https://github.com/SuperUserA))
- Extension transcript presenters (`setTranscriptPresenters`, `readTranscriptPresentation`, `TranscriptPresentationState` in `chat/transcript-presentation`) draw tool cards and read entries full, compact or hidden ([#17960](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17960) by [@materemias](https://github.com/materemias))
- `PresentedBlock` applies transcript presenters to advisor, skill, execution, background-job, TTSR and other non-tool blocks; `TtsrNotificationComponent.rules` exposes its merged rules ([#17997](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17997) by [@materemias](https://github.com/materemias))
- `LinkBrowserComponent` (`overlays/link-browser`) browses a transcript fullscreen with stable link hint tags; `LinkHints` / `viewportLinkTargets()` share tagging with `Composer`; `ChatTranscriptBuilder` accepts `textRenderers` ([#16476](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16476) by [@materemias](https://github.com/materemias))
- `cache` status-line segment with warm/cold indicators, plus `StatusLineSession.getPromptCacheStatus`, `icon.cacheWarm` / `icon.cacheCold`, the `omp.composer.cache` fact and `promptCacheBrief` / `promptCacheDetails` helpers ([#12677](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/12677)) ([#17496](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17496) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- `^` model mentions suggest supported effort levels after `:` and refresh as you type via optional `AutocompleteProvider.trySyncModelMentionCompletion`, so Tab accepts the current row ([#17574](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17574) by [@a-glapinski](https://github.com/a-glapinski))
- Shared spinner clock (`spinner-clock`: `setSpinnerInterval`, `sharedSpinnerFrame`, `spinnerTickDelay`) ticks all spinners together; `0` makes them static ([#14240](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14240) by [@mccraigmccraig](https://github.com/mccraigmccraig))
- Frame-rate ceiling (`frame-rate`: `setMaxFps`, `minFrameIntervalMs`) for rendering and animations; frames awaited by a keystroke keep 30 fps ([#14240](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14240) by [@mccraigmccraig](https://github.com/mccraigmccraig))
- `setMotionEffects` (`motion-effects`) turns off decorative motion: status-line blink, brand fade, magic-keyword sweep and native `fx` spans ([#14240](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14240) by [@mccraigmccraig](https://github.com/mccraigmccraig))
- `CompactTranscriptBlock` (`chrome/transcript-container`): consecutive blocks whose `isTranscriptBlockCompact()` is true render without blank rows between them, in terminal and native (TSP) surfaces ([#17997](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17997) by [@materemias](https://github.com/materemias))

- Ask cards drop per-question section headers; each question shows its id and flags inline (`(db · 3 options)`) ([#18104](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18104) by [@JustasMasiulis](https://github.com/JustasMasiulis))

- Added `getUpdateStateDir()`, returning the auto-update state directory (`~/.omp/update`).
- Added `logger.setLogForwarder()` and `logger.emitForeign()` to forward log records across threads, preserving context and timestamps.
- Added `expandTilde()` to expand a leading `~` to the home directory.

### Fixed

- Fixed `spawn`/`exec` timeouts never firing when the command's root exited before `spawn()` returned, which let a descendant holding stdout or stderr stall output reads until it exited.
- `ptree` commands with `subreaper: true` now reliably terminate all descendants on graceful shutdown.
- `fatal()` in a worker thread now reaches the parent's `error` listeners instead of only exiting with code 1.
- Fixed the terminal stderr guard leaking a copy of the terminal into processes spawned from native code.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-wire

### Added

- Added shell trace visualization: `ShellTrace` model and TSP `shell` kind for shell runs, node state, and layout.
- Code views gain score-based line shading, labeled collapsible folds with notes, tones, and hover cards, and an overview strip.

name: v3.24.2 — An honest null for experiment locks, repro_lock alignment, and a corrected sr-screener methods sentence
body:
> **Repairs and docs; no new skill or mode, and the prompt-level changes are unmeasured:** An `experiment_provenance[]` entry can now say it has no honest lock values, with `repro_lock: null` and a `repro_lock_reason` (#1049). A survey or an analysis with no LLM could pass before only with placeholder values. Earlier ARS releases reject this form, so a passport that uses it needs this release. `check_repro_lock.py` now fails a required value that breaks its field's type or value rule, such as a null model id; `cross_model.secondary_model_id` may still be null. `planned_vs_executed[].value` accepts only a number or a string, so some passports that passed before now fail (#1050). The `sr-screener` methods text no longer says the reviewers could read only the record file: the tool list removes web and write access, and reading only the given file is an instruction (#1039). SETUP records two checks in which an uploaded skill dispatched a built-in sub-agent in a conversation after a retry; multi-agent stages stay untested (#1040).

### Fixed

- **An experiment with no honest lock values can say so (#1049, PR #1051).** Every `experiment_provenance[]` entry had to fill every `repro_lock` field, and those fields describe LLM and ARS run settings. A survey, an analysis with no LLM, or a trained model with no ARS prompts could pass only with placeholder values. The key stays required. Its value may now be `null`, and `repro_lock_reason` is then required; a reason beside a populated lock is rejected. The reason is free text: it discloses the gap, does not prove the lock does not apply, and no script checks the details it names. The passport-level validator and the required-field set do not change. **Compatibility:** earlier ARS releases reject `repro_lock: null` in an entry, so a passport that uses it needs this release.
- **`repro_lock` docs, example, gate, and validators agree (#1050, PR #1052).** `check_repro_lock.py` now checks each required value against its field's type or value rule, matching the nested entry schema. `cross_model.secondary_model_id` may be null or any string, and the other string fields must be non-empty. A drift test compares the two on required keys, supported values, and a fixed set of wrong and edge-case values, not on every possible value, and extra keys stay the one known difference. The example passport gains a passport-level lock, and its two trained-model experiments use `repro_lock: null` with a reason. The D7 text in the integrity gate names 3.12.0 as the boundary and adds a fifth FAIL condition, a post-#260 passport with status `legacy_unknown`. The pattern doc no longer says a version change alters the prompt hashes, because they hash only the prompt files. **Compatibility:** a populated lock with a required value that breaks these rules now fails when `check_repro_lock.py` is run on it, and `planned_vs_executed[].value` accepts only a number or a string. Some passports that passed before now fail. The gate text is prompt-level and its effect is unmeasured.
- **The `sr-screener` methods text states what the tool list enforces (#1039, PR #1043).** `tools: Read, Grep` removes web and write access but does not confine Read and Grep to one file. The title/abstract and full-text methods text now say: "The reviewer agents had read-only file tools and no web access; each was instructed to read only the file it was given." Methods text generated by an earlier release keeps the old sentence, so an author who used it should correct it by hand.

### Docs

- **SETUP records what an uploaded skill did on Claude Desktop (#1040, PR #1045).** Claude Desktop refused an upload named `deep-research` because Anthropic already provides a skill with that name, so Method 3 (en/zh-TW) now zips a copy named `ars-deep-research`, with the skill folder at the top of the zip. In two checks on 2026-11-02, the uploaded skill dispatched a built-in `Explore` sub-agent in a conversation; each time the first dispatch did not run and a retry did. Method 4a drops its 200-character and no-sub-agent claims and points to Method 3. `docs/CONTROL_AVAILABILITY.md` marks Cowork subagent orchestration and `sr-screener` dual review as Untested and adds note 12; a single dispatch is not multi-agent orchestration.
- **`docs/SETUP.zh-TW.md` and `README.zh-TW.md` drop their double em dashes (PR #1044).** The 14 marks became colons, commas, or parentheses, with no content change.

name: ctx7@0.10.0
body:
### Minor Changes

- 9783083: Add Pi to `ctx7 setup` and `ctx7 remove`. `ctx7 setup --pi` writes the Context7 MCP server to `~/.pi/agent/mcp.json` (or `.pi/mcp.json` with `--project`) with `direct` tool exposure. It also adds the Context7 rule to Pi's context file and installs the skill in `~/.agents/skills`. Pi reads one context file per folder, so setup adds the rule to an existing `AGENTS.override.md` or `CLAUDE.md` instead of creating an `AGENTS.md` that would hide it. Setup honors `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR`, and with `--oauth` it prints the `pi mcp login context7` step.

### Patch Changes

- 505b812: Keep your comments when `ctx7 setup` or `ctx7 remove` touches an MCP config. `.vscode/mcp.json` and `.cursor/mcp.json` are JSONC, and the CLI accepted them for reading but wrote them back through `JSON.stringify`, so every comment and any layout you kept in the file was silently dropped. The Context7 entry is now added or removed with an in-place edit that leaves the rest of the file alone, comments included. A file the edit cannot handle safely, such as one whose trailing comma would be stranded, is still rewritten whole as before.
- db66f7a: Fix `ctx7 setup` and `ctx7 remove` leaving the Context7 section in an AGENTS.md or GEMINI.md that has CRLF line endings.
- ff0422f: Add a T3 Code setup choice and --t3 setup/remove flag that configure its Claude Code and Codex providers.

name: fresh-editor 0.5.8
body:
## 0.5.8

For live updates on Fresh, [follow me on X](https://x.com/TheNoamLewis).

> Most config options below can be changed in the **Settings UI** - run **Open Settings** from the command palette (`Ctrl+P`).

### Features

* **Auto-hide the tab bar** - **Auto Hide Tab Bar** (Settings > Editor > Display) hides it while a single file is open (#3696, requested by @garfunkel)
* **Explorer folder colour can be themed** separately from syntax keywords (#3697, requested by @mommysgoodpuppy)
* **Option+Backspace / Option+Delete delete words on macOS** (#3643, requested by @gaojunran)
* **Go to Next / Previous Paragraph** are in the command palette and Go menu (#2122)
* **Explorer sticky-parent band is shaded** so pinned rows read as a distinct strip (#3625, by @PavelLoparev)

### Bug Fixes

* **Search/Replace panel is per window** - Alt+A in a second window opens its own panel (#3704, reported by @alt-freem)
* **Replace All no longer rewrites a file twice** under a symlinked root or tracked symlink (#3720)
* **Find Next ignores matches an edit removed** instead of walking stale results (#3464, #3444, reported by @mandolyte)
* **Markdown** - Tab honours the configured tab size (#3713, reported by @hbarel) and indents a selection or multiple cursors (#3666, reported by @dnikic)
* **Python `match`/`case` and more C++ keywords are highlighted**; `.c` files use the C grammar (#3509, #3644, #3716, reported by @asukaminato0721)
* **Bash highlighting survives `f() ( ... )` subshell functions** (#3473, #3201, reported by @asukaminato0721)
* **C# typing lag** from slow highlighting of interpolated strings is gone (#3667, #3699, reported by @SONickode)
* **LSP servers that declare full text sync** receive the whole document, so their diagnostics stay (#3436, reported by @dsvarela)
* **Terminal Shell set from `init.ts`** applies to new terminals (#3712, reported by @brunnerh)
* **Merge conflict resolution** no longer leaves an extra blank line per conflict (#3702, #3714, reported by @atk)
* **`fresh --diff` fixes** - stray tab, click past line end, modified markers (#3688, #3689, #3691, #3694, reported by @Korkman)
* **Keys work on macOS when stdin is `/dev/tty`** instead of hanging and spinning a core (#3683, #3693, reported by @StonesFromTheSky)
* **Open File: Enter on a partial dotfile name** opens the highlighted directory (#3680, by @StonesFromTheSky)
* **Scrolling Markdown is smoother** and idle CPU no longer spins during debounce (#3701)

### Internals

* Reduced flaky tests.

- 在等待搜索结果期间识别延迟重定向，并覆盖结果就绪后、导航后停顿期间的跳转。

- 保留正常空结果行为，补齐本地浏览器回归测试。感谢 @SamYunquChen 的修复与测试贡献。[#872](https://github.com/xpzouying/xiaohongshu-mcp/pull/872)
- 更新贡献者名单和赞赏记录。[#909](https://github.com/xpzouying/xiaohongshu-mcp/pull/909) · [#908](https://github.com/xpzouying/xiaohongshu-mcp/pull/908)

name: v5.1.62
body:
## What changed

**omo verifies the device service it downloads against the real release key set.** The device service's release key set is now pinned to the minted Ed25519 keys, operational first and recovery second, in `packages/device-service-core/src/release/release-key.json` (a byte copy of the service's own `release-key.json`). A release signed by either key installs; one signed by neither, or with a malformed signature, is refused before anything is written. Until now the pin was a placeholder that refused every release. ([#12437](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12437))

**Skills and prompts no longer point at skills, files or agents that do not exist, and CI now refuses any new one.** The Native ultrawork directive told sessions to read the `bun-1-4` skill, which Senpi renamed to `bun`; it now names `bun`. `remove-deadcode` asked for a `typescript-programmer` skill, which made OpenCode refuse the whole `task` call; it now loads `programming`. `frontend` and `ulw-research` no longer load an `open-design` skill that omo never shipped and instead name the nexu-io/open-design library. The `ulw-research` assembly worker loads `imagegen` and `ulw-loop` only when the session lists them, and `frontend` loads the `browser` skill where it asked for OpenCode's `playwright`. OpenCode now ships the `hyperplan` skill that its hyperplan mode tells the session to load; until now only this repository's own checkout had it. Seven `programming` references and one `frontend` cross-reference that pointed at files in the wrong directory, or at a file that never existed, now open the right file. A new check in the root test suite resolves every skill name, skill-relative path, agent and category in shipped skills and prompts for each edition that ships them, and names the closest real target when one is missing. ([#12484](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12484))

When omo drops the OpenSSL default certificate file (`/etc/ssl/cert.pem` on macOS) from the engine's trust store, it now tells you why. `omo doctor` prints an INFO line naming the file, the cause, the certificate block where reading stopped, and whether the drop trusts fewer certificates than plain Bun would. `omo trust ensure --json` reports the same facts as `defaultFileDrop`. It is never a warning or a failure. ([#12499](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12499), part of [#10762](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10762))

<!-- changes-log: packages/omo-native/changes.md -->
## 2026-11-05 - Name the OpenSSL default-file drop (#12499, part of #10762)

Design revision 11, 4.4 item 6. `readDefaultFileCandidates` takes its narrowing flags from the exported `DROP_CAUSE_NARROWING` table. On a drop, `acquireEngineTrust` records one `openssl-default-file-malformed` entry carrying `file`, `cause`, `blockIndex` and `narrowing` instead of two plain codes, and returns it as `defaultFileDrop`. `runTrustStage` prints it in the `trust ensure --json` line. `trust-diagnostics.ts` accepts that structured entry and still accepts the plain code for an unreadable file; it refuses another file name, an unknown cause, a non-integer block index or a narrowing flag that does not match the cause. `engine-trust-doctor.ts` reads the adopted generation's `diagnostics.1.jsonl` and `diagnostics.jsonl`, takes the last `import-exec` or `ensure` record of that generation, and gives `omo doctor` one INFO line: the drop, or `default-file: kept` / `unreadable`. A missing or torn log yields no line and never fails doctor.

**Native skills no longer point Senpi sessions at OpenCode-only agents, tools and commands.** A community audit of the installed skills found 16 more references that exist only in OpenCode or nowhere: `refactor` consulted an `oracle` agent and called `team_list` and `team_status`, `debugging` ended a team with `team_shutdown_request` and `team_approve_shutdown`, `frontend` loaded skills through a `skill` tool and addressed a `Prometheus` planner, `ulw-loop` named an `explorer` agent, a `plan` agent and a `/cancel` command, `ulw-plan` offered a `git` category, and `ultimate-browsing` named a `web-search` tool and Playwright MCP calls. Senpi now gets the `deep-high` lane in place of `oracle`, the `task_send` shutdown handshake and `task_output` in place of the missing team tools, and `explore`, the `ulw-plan` workflow and `/goal pause` or `/goal clear` in the Native skills. The shared skills read the same in OpenCode and Codex. ([#12523](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12523))

### Changed

- A Linux container matrix (Debian, Fedora, Alpine, openSUSE Leap and Tumbleweed) now checks the compiled engine's CA import on each distribution: the bundle chosen from `os-release` is the one the engine reads, a root installed with `update-ca-certificates` or `update-ca-trust` is trusted, and a root placed only in openSUSE's `/var/lib/ca-certificates/openssl` is not. ([#12223](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12223), part of [#10762](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10762))

- The engine CA importer's design 9.7 mutation checks now run in CI for the trust code in `packages/omo-native`: `script/omo-native-trust-mutations.ts` applies each mutation as a source patch to a disposable copy of the package, requires its named test to turn red, and requires the same test to pass on the unpatched copy. It covers 31 source mutations (trust policy, launcher trust stage, user extras, generation retention, the OpenSSL hash-directory and default-file selectors) and 2 oracle self-checks, fails when a mutation's patch no longer matches exactly once, and runs in the new `Engine trust mutations` workflow on every change under `packages/omo-native`. Rows owned by senpi, the desktop or the macOS and Windows adapters run in their own pipelines. ([#12495](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12495), part of [#10762](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10762))

- Senpi task and LSP tool descriptions now say what the tools do: `task_cancel` releases a finished child's resident session or queued messages, `task_send`'s 32 KB cap covers team messages only and a message can queue, `task_output`'s tail mode shares the character cap, `task_id` wins over `name`, and `lsp_find_references`, `lsp_symbols` and `lsp_diagnostics` state their 200-result cap and defaults. Text only; no behavior change. ([#12500](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12500), fixes [#12496](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12496))

### Fixed

- `omo trust ensure` now reports `trust-lease-failed` when it cannot refresh the recency of a generation it reuses, instead of silently handing out a generation the retention sweep may remove next. ([#12163](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12163), part of [#10762](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10762))

- On Fedora, RHEL and other systems whose CA bundle carries non-ASCII comment lines between certificates (such as `# NetLock Arany (Class Gold) Főtanúsítvány`), the compiled engine now imports the system roots instead of discarding the whole bundle as malformed and falling back. Non-ASCII text inside a certificate block still discards the file. ([#12220](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12220), part of [#10762](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10762))

- A device whose memory-sync sign-in ends (revoked, signed out, `omo logout`, `omo account forget --device`, or replaced by a new sign-in) no longer keeps its sync trust pin, so `omo account show --account` stops reporting it as joined and re-pairing after a reset is no longer blocked. Joining again always goes through the pairing or recovery ceremony. The new `omo account retire-sync --account <id>` does the same for a desktop-owned session. ([#12280](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12280))

- `omo doctor` now reports a generated `omo` wrapper whose cached runtime is gone instead of passing over it in silence: `WARN broken omo on PATH: <file> launches <missing path>; remove it`, with no repair installer offered for the broken wrapper. It also warns when two different omo-ai installs (for example bun and npm) are both on PATH, where previously only installs of different kinds were flagged. Broken detection does not run for Windows `.cmd` wrappers: they write `rem OMO_GENERATED_RUNTIME_WRAPPER` while the check looks for the `#` marker. ([#12534](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12534), fixes [#12110](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12110))

<!-- changes-log: packages/omo-native/changes.md -->
## 2026-11-05 - Doctor reports a broken omo wrapper and duplicate omo-ai installs (#12534)

`omo doctor` now reports a generated `omo` wrapper whose cached runtime is gone, and warns when two different omo-ai installs are both on PATH. Windows `.cmd` wrappers are not covered by the broken check: they write `rem OMO_GENERATED_RUNTIME_WRAPPER` while the check looks for the `#` marker.

### Known issues

- Engine TLS trust v1: distrusted intermediate certificates under an allowed root are not yet blocked; tracked upstream. The compiled engine now has tests for every TLS path (global `fetch`, `Bun.fetch`, a saved `fetch`, a Worker `fetch`, `node:https` and `WebSocket`): a root outside the selected set or denied by the OS fails on all of them, a store intermediate is used only when its usage allows server authentication and it is not denied, and a test named `limitation-pin:` records that a denied intermediate the server itself presents under an allowed root is still accepted. ([#12219](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12219), part of [#10762](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10762))

name: v5.1.61
body:
Runs on senpi 2026.11.3-3: Claude Opus and Fable get their full system prompt back (the pre-diet wording; every other model keeps the slimmer prompt), Anthropic Subscription no longer refuses a working Claude login as blocked when an older omo process is still running or when Claude Code can't read its login behind a locked keychain, a usage limit with an ISO reset time blocks that account until the reset instead of retrying every minute, a goal waits for the first limited account to come back instead of spending turns, and Shift+Enter inserts a newline in macOS Terminal.app. ([#12311](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12311))

Runs on senpi 2026.11.3-3: the engine socket can now send compact message updates (`compact_message_updates_v1`) with `event_resync` recovery, so long streamed turns cost less to relay. It stays off unless `SENPI_ENGINE_SOCKET_COMPACT_UPDATES=1` is set. (Part of [code-yeongyu/senpi#4272](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/4272)) ([#12215](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12215))

**macOS computer use keeps the display awake while it operates, and says when the screen is locked or asleep.** The engine now holds a `PreventUserIdleDisplaySleep` power assertion ("OmO computer use is operating the desktop" in `pmset -g assertions`) from the first request other than `capabilities`, `control.state` and `stopPath.*` until 60 seconds after the last one; `session.close`, a disconnect and a stop release it at once. `capabilities.displayAsleep` reports when every display of the session sleeps, `omo doctor` prints it on the display line, and a `CaptureFailed`, `InputFailed` or `Timeout` message ends with `(the screen is locked)` or `(the display is asleep)` when that is the likely cause. Other platforms are unchanged. ([#11530](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11530), part of [#11466](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11466))

### Fixed

- In the desktop's first-run setup, "Understanding you" no longer stops with "No retained scan with this id" after About you brings anything in. Applying an onboarding scan now keeps it available to understanding until the scan expires; a scan is still applied only once. ([#12509](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12509), fixes [#12508](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12508))
- The engine now registers its agent dir with the device service even when the service's state directory appears right after the engine started (for example, when the device service is installed or started at the same moment). A freshly armed directory watch can miss an entry created in its first milliseconds, so the registrant never noticed the service and other devices listed no sessions. Each watch arm now re-checks the path once after it settles. ([#12482](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12482))
- Your other signed-in devices now see this device's sessions after the OmO device service starts or restarts. Every `omo` engine, in the terminal and the ones the desktop app starts, keeps its own agent directory registered with the device service and registers it again when the service comes back or the device is signed in again; it never holds an engine open and stays off with `"device_service": { "enabled": false }`. ([#12380](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12380), fixes [#12379](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12379))
- A reflection sandbox probe that timed out once (for example on a busy machine) no longer turns the sandbox off until restart. Reflection checks again on its next run, so it runs sandboxed again once bwrap responds. A machine where bwrap definitively cannot create a sandbox is still checked only once (#12376). A reflection run that falls back to running unsandboxed because bwrap is unusable at that moment is now logged once as a degraded sandbox, and once more when the sandbox comes back, instead of passing silently. ([#12378](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12378))
- A session whose Stop was released but whose background children stayed paused, refusing every new task with "Task admission is held by your Stop", is released by the next message you send. `/resume` and new prompts used to do nothing because the session no longer held a Stop, so only `/reload` or a restart cleared it (#12342). ([#12343](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12343))
- Revoking a memory-sync device, `omo logout`, or signing out on the desktop no longer freezes every other device's pushes. A remaining device now rotates the account memory key so the removed device is excluded, and it can no longer read notes written after it was removed. While a key change is pending, the status shows sync as blocked instead of claiming it is synced. ([#12280](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12280)) ([#12302](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12302))
- The dev-browser CDP-port test "with no grace window it still runs cleanly under set -u" now waits for the port holder to exit before it checks that the holder received SIGTERM. Under host load it could fail even though the release worked (#12287). ([#12293](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12293))
- Memory sync replicates between devices again. The client refused every batch row from `GET /v1/sync/entries` that carried the `batch_id` the service contract declares, so two devices paired but no edit reached the other. Account recovery, and pairing a device after the first batch, failed the same way. A well-formed `batch_id` on a batch row is now accepted. A null or malformed one, one on a keyring row, and any other extra field are still refused (#12277). ([#12292](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12292))
- Background task children that a Stop paused are resumed again when you type after the Stop. The run's Resume used to miss them because the Stop's own run fences raised the session's pause sequence, so they stayed `paused` for hours while the task widget showed them as `running` or `starting` (#12249). ([#12268](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12268))
- A paused child that its run's Resume cannot restore is retried a few times and then ends as an error the parent is told about, instead of staying paused forever. Its transcript is kept for `task_output`. ([#12268](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12268))
- The task widget shows a paused child as `paused`, with no running clock, and `/task-kill` offers paused children. ([#12268](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12268))
- Memory reflection children started inside the Linux bubblewrap sandbox no longer exit at startup with `unsafe trust ancestor`. Inside the sandbox's user namespace, root-owned directories show the overflow uid. The engine trust stage now accepts one only when the launcher verified, from outside the sandbox, that this exact inode is root-owned. A directory owned by another user is still refused. The sandbox child also gets its own private `TMPDIR`, and a read-only trust directory falls back to a private temporary one. A hand-made user namespace that omo cannot verify now gets the named refusal `trust-userns-unattested` with a next step, instead of a stack trace. ([#12079](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12079), code-yeongyu/senpi#5334)
- RPC liveness tests keep pre-existing async work on the real clock, so unrelated timers cannot be mistaken for leaked session timers during confirmed close. The regression injects a foreign timer while the session is terminal-pending and retains every close and cleanup assertion. ([#11937](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11937), fixes [#11934](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11934))
- Keep buffered logging on its own scheduler and cancellation pair so virtual clocks used by RPC callers cannot capture log flushes ([#11687](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11687), landing the work from #11641)
- A disposed process child no longer sends anything or arms a timer after its teardown: a late abort, steer, finished-turn check or state probe is refused at once instead of waiting out a 10-30 s request deadline, an extension UI request it sends after teardown gets no automatic answer written back, a closed-pipe error reported after teardown no longer arms the exit grace timer, and a heartbeat probe whose launch lands after its heartbeat stopped is skipped ([#11687](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11687), part of [#11673](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11673))
- A memory session's shutdown now waits for every memory read still running in its identity directory: the compiled-block and recall-corpus caches, every memory hook and memory tool call in flight (a prompt turn, a settle, a `memory` tool write), the bind-time reconcile, and detached dream requests are all tracked, so no `git` child outlives `session_shutdown` and Windows no longer fails the next removal of that directory with EBUSY ([#11671](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11671), part of [#11135](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11135); the probe case is [#11136](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11136))

### Changed

- Thread tools no longer refuse a chain of messages at its fifth hop, at 64 messages, or when it comes back to a session it passed (A to B to A): a chain has no hidden count limit. A chain continued after its 7-day root lifetime is delivered under a fresh root instead of being refused. A session still cannot message itself. ([#12331](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12331), part of [#12320](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12320))
- Thread tools and subagent, workflow, workpool and team tools declare that they run on the loop side of a split session (`runs: "brain"`); sessions that are not split behave exactly as before. ([#12324](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12324), part of [#12320](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12320))
- The OmO Native extension's main bundle is about 27.9 KB smaller: the two ultrawork directive variants store their shared text once instead of twice. Both directives are unchanged. ([#12291](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12291))

### Added

- Every interactive `omo` start now sets up this device's OmO device service in the background once you are signed in, so your other signed-in devices can see and command its sessions. It never delays the start and speaks up only when it stops on something you can fix. Turn it off with `"device_service": { "enabled": false }` in omo.json, or keep it and stop other devices from controlling this one with `omo remote control off` (`omo remote control` shows the setting). ([#12257](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12257), part of [#12051](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12051))

name: CC Switch v4.0.26
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.26

本版本让授权中心和官方供应商卡片显示每个账号的订阅计划，GitHub Copilot 账号会列出所有有上限的额度；一键导入链接现在也能导入 Claude Desktop、MiniMax Code、Kimi Code、DeepSeek Harness 和 Oh My Pi 的供应商。Codex 卡片可以选择保留 GPT 模型的官方 Fast 档；系统代理把 Codex、Grok Build 发往本地路由的请求接走时，CC Switch 会提醒你。DeepSeek Harness 可以设置配置目录，装在 WSL 里也能管理。这一版还做了一轮性能优化：供应商列表、主窗口加载、启动、会话读取和路由转发都更快，会话同步占着数据库时界面也不再卡住。另外修复了 IPv6 不通时经路由请求先卡两分多钟、需要登录的 MCP 服务器显示连接失败、Claude Desktop 路由卡片改了模型不生效、Codex 经路由转 Chat 时缓存命中率下降、GitHub Copilot 的 Grok 请求报 422 和回复重复显示、非 Retina 显示器上弹窗模糊等问题。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 [v4.0 发布说明](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.4-zh.md)。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.26-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.26-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

### 账号订阅计划

以前授权中心里只有 Claude 账号会写订阅计划，其他账号只显示登录日期，同一个服务的 Max 账号和 Free 账号看起来一模一样。

现在 GitHub Copilot、ChatGPT、Kimi、Antigravity、xAI 账号的第二行开头也会写订阅计划。Codex、Kimi、Antigravity、Gemini CLI 的官方卡片，以及 Copilot、xAI 账号卡片，副标题后面也会加上「· 计划名」。

- 卡片上的计划名直接用额度查询的结果，不会多发请求（Kimi、Antigravity、xAI 查额度时会多一个并行请求取计划名）；额度加载出来后计划名才出现，不查额度的卡片不显示。
- 计划名查不到时只是不显示，额度照常显示；刷新失败时保留上次查到的计划。
- 跟随 Grok CLI 登录的 Grok Build 卡片、没绑账号的 Antigravity 卡片暂时还没有计划名，它们查额度的方式拿不到这项信息。

### GitHub Copilot 显示全部额度

Copilot 账号以前只显示高级请求的百分比。现在每一项有上限的额度各占一行，悬停可以看到「剩余 / 共」，Free 账号的代码补全和聊天次数也能看到了。

- 高级请求改叫 Credits，和 Codex 的叫法一致，托盘里也一样。
- Free 账号没有 Credits，以前会显示成「还剩 100%」，现在写「当前计划不含」，供应商卡片上不再显示这一项。

### 一键导入支持更多应用

以前 Claude Desktop、MiniMax Code、Kimi Code、DeepSeek Harness 和 Oh My Pi 的供应商链接会直接被拒绝。现在这些应用的链接也能导入了。

- **Claude Desktop**：链接是 Anthropic 格式、模型名都以 `claude-` 开头（或没写模型）时，导入成直连卡片；其他情况导入成模型映射卡片，四个档位按链接里的模型填好。
- **MiniMax Code、Kimi Code、DeepSeek Harness、Oh My Pi**：和 Pi 一样导入成单个模型，链接里必须带模型。
- Oh My Pi 会把某些写法的 Key 当成环境变量名或命令来读，导入后可能把你本机的密钥发到链接里的地址。所以这类 Key（以 `!` 开头、没有小写字母等）会被拒绝导入。

### Codex 卡片保留官方 Fast 档

Codex 第三方卡片模型列表里的 GPT 模型以前一律去掉了官方的 Fast 速度档，选不了 Fast（[#5234](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/5234)）。转发官方 ChatGPT 账号的中转（如 CPA）其实支持 Fast。

现在 Codex 供应商表单「高级选项」里，「上游格式」下面多了「保留官方 Fast 档」，默认关闭，只在上游格式为 Responses 时显示。打开后 Codex 选了 Fast 时请求会带 `service_tier=priority`。

- 只有转发官方 ChatGPT 账号的中转才认，会更快消耗额度；其他上游可能报错或按更高价格计费。
- 以前在官方卡片下选过 Fast 的，打开后会马上在这家生效。聚合模式下不生效，改完需要重启 Codex。

### 系统代理接走本地路由时提醒

开着 Clash 这类代理工具时，Codex 和 Grok Build 发往本地路由（`http://127.0.0.1:<port>`）的请求可能被系统代理接走，转到远程节点后返回一个空的 502（[#9221](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9221)）。Codex 只显示「502 Bad Gateway」，CC Switch 这边也收不到请求，没有任何日志，很难查。

现在 Codex 或 Grok Build 进入路由模式后，CC Switch 会在后台按客户端同样的代理规则给本地路由发一次请求。请求回不来时，日志里会记一条警告；如果是你手动进入路由模式，界面上也会弹出提示，说明怎么在代理工具里让本机地址直连（例如在 Clash 规则最前面加 `IP-CIDR,127.0.0.0/8,DIRECT,no-resolve`）。

### DeepSeek Harness 配置目录

以前 DeepSeek Harness 只认 `DSH_HOME` 或 `~/.dsh`，装在 WSL 里的 DSH 在 Windows 版 CC Switch 里管不了（[#9239](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9239)）。

现在「设置 → 应用配置」里多了 DeepSeek Harness 一栏，可以设置配置目录。供应商、Skills、指令文件、会话和用量导入都会跟着这个目录走。填 WSL 里的路径时，版本检测、安装和升级也会在那个 WSL 发行版里进行。

---

## 变更

- **性能优化**：
  - 供应商列表读取更快，供应商越多越明显；没改动的供应商不再重复写入数据库，也就不会因此触发云同步（[#9180](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9180)）。
  - 次要页面和供应商编辑器改为用到时才加载，主窗口启动要加载的脚本少了一半（[#9181](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9181)）。
  - 启动时的日志清理挪到后台进行；窗口隐藏或最小化时暂停定时刷新，窗口可见但不在前台时照常刷新（[#9182](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9182)）。
  - 读取会话记录时少复制一遍数据，进入轻量模式后会释放会话缓存（[#9183](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9183)）。
  - 路由转发流式响应时少了大量内存复制，响应很长时尤其明显；故障转移读数据库的次数也更少（[#9161](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9161)）。
- **会话同步时界面不再卡住**（[#9178](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9178)）：大会话文件同步时会占着数据库几十秒，这期间打开 Skills 页、切到 Pi 或 Oh My Pi、打开网络或数据设置、图标选择、统一供应商面板、测速等操作会让整个窗口和托盘卡住，直到同步结束。现在这些操作都在后台等待，界面照常响应。
- **会话阅读页的工具栏重新排版**（[#9109](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9109)）：第一行放路径和阅读工具，第二行放时间、会话统计、模型和用量；去掉了容易落在行首行尾的分隔点，模型名太长时换行显示，悬停可看完整名称。
- **预设：** Grok Build 默认模型改为 `grok-4.7`，Kimi 预设（Codex 的除外）默认模型改为 `kimi-k3.1-pro`，Hermes 的千问 Coding Plan 默认模型改为 `qwen3.7-plus`（[#9193](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9193)）；TeamoRouter 改用 teamorouter.com 域名；Claude Desktop 官方卡片的下载链接改为 claude.com/download。已添加的供应商不受影响。

---

## 修复

- **IPv6 不通时，经路由的请求要先卡两分多钟才发出**（[#9212](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9212)）。智谱 GLM、阿里云百炼等服务的域名会先解析出 IPv6 地址，在 IPv6 不通的网络里，本地路由要等系统把每个 IPv6 地址都超时一遍才改用 IPv4，macOS 上约 150 秒、Windows 上约 43 秒。现在 IPv6 地址 300 毫秒内连不上就同时尝试 IPv4，发出的请求内容不变。
- **需要登录的 MCP 服务器，连通性检查显示「连接失败」**（[#9190](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9190)）。Notion、Sentry 这类服务器需要 OAuth 登录，客户端里登录后能正常用，但 CC Switch 检查时不带客户端的登录凭据，就被判成了失败。现在这种情况显示黄色圆点，悬停会说明服务器能连上、只是要求登录。CC Switch 仍然不读取客户端保存的登录凭据。
- **Claude Desktop 路由卡片改了模型后，Claude Desktop 里还是旧模型，删掉重建才行**（[#9203](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9203)）。保存时「菜单显示名」留空会自动填成模型名，之后只改模型时显示名还是旧的。现在显示名和旧模型名一样时会跟着新模型一起改，你自己起的名字保持不变。
- **Codex 经路由转 Chat 时，对话中途改了设置后缓存命中率下降**。比如中途切换 `sandbox_mode` 后，Codex 会在这一轮开头插入一条说明，以前它被合并到对话最开头，改写了整段历史，上游缓存就全部失效了。现在这条说明留在原位，之前的历史保持不变。
- **Codex 经路由转 Chat 时，可能把另一个会话的思考内容混进当前会话**。上游给的工具调用 ID 容易重复（如 `exec_command:0`），本地路由重启或缓存被挤掉后，可能找到别的会话里同名的调用。现在按 Codex 会话区分，只在同一个会话里找。
- **路由请求失败时，请求日志里记的是客户端的模型名**。比如 Claude Desktop 的后台任务用的是 `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001`，映射到这张卡片的模型后上游报 429，日志里却显示 Haiku，看起来像调用了一个你没配过的模型。现在失败的请求和成功的一样，会写成「`claude-haiku-4-5-20251001` → 实际模型」。
- **跟随本机登录的 Claude 官方卡片，登录过期后一直显示「令牌待刷新」，要再跑一次 Claude Code 才恢复**。现在登录过期时 CC Switch 会让 Claude Code 自己刷新登录，再读取额度。设置了 Claude 配置目录时跳过。
- **Claude Code 和 Claude Desktop 自动模式的安全分类器不可用时，客户端会一直重试、持续消耗额度**（[#9201](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9201)、[#9199](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9199)）。现在连续 3 轮工具结果都报告分类器不可用时，本地路由直接返回错误，不再发给上游；发一条新消息即可继续。
- **Codex 通过 GitHub Copilot 用 Grok 模型时报 422**（[#7989](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/7989)、[#7988](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7988)）。现在 Copilot 的 Grok 请求和直连 xAI 一样做兼容处理。
- **Codex 通过 GitHub Copilot 时，同一条回复显示两遍**（[#8025](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8025)、[#7977](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7977)）。
- **安装或升级应用时撞上已有的同名文件，提示里只有 npm 建议的 `--force`**（[#9196](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9196)、[#9173](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9173)）。这个文件多半来自另一种安装方式，用 `--force` 会直接覆盖它。现在提示会写出冲突的文件路径，建议先改名备份再重试。
- **Skills 里有文件软链接时，WebDAV 自动同步失败**（[#9197](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9197)）。比如 `CLAUDE.md` 和 `GEMINI.md` 都链接到 `AGENTS.md` 时，打包会出现重名文件。现在每个文件保留自己的名字。
- **Codex 子代理并发上限的两个问题**（[#9148](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9148)）：`config.toml` 里表头后面带注释时，改上限可能覆盖掉 `[features.multi_agent_v2]`；`[agents]` 写成带引号的键名时，会多写一个 Codex 不认的重复字段。说明文字也补充了改动只对新会话生效。
- **DeepSeek Harness 用 headless profile 时找不到 CC Switch 保存的 Key**，报 `MISSING_CREDENTIAL`。现在写入 headless profile 时会按 DSH 文档开启凭据读取；你自己改过这一项的 profile 保持不变。
- **在 1x 显示器上，「选择模型」等弹窗显示模糊**（[#9238](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9238)）。弹窗居中时可能落在半个像素上，非 Retina 显示器上文字和边框会发虚。
- **macOS 上，在 MCP 表单、提示词编辑、Skills 仓库、会话搜索等输入框里打字时首字母被自动改成大写**，环境变量名、请求头、命令、地址可能因此被存错。
- **Linux AppImage 打包了旧版 libwayland-client**（[#9229](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9229)、[#8723](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8723)），在 Intel 核显加 Wayland 的环境下可能打不开。

---

## 致谢

感谢 @YUZHEthefool（供应商列表、页面加载、启动和会话读取四项性能优化）、@allenxu09（路由转发性能、会话阅读页工具栏）、@thisTom（会话同步时界面卡住）、@EdwinDigital（GitHub Copilot 的 Grok 请求和重复回复）、@jasontospas（安全分类器重试循环）、@funkpopo（子代理并发上限修复）、@zydo（预设默认模型）、@Logic-Bin（npm 同名文件冲突提示）、@paigeman（Skills 软链接同步）、@nekoteai（Linux AppImage）的贡献。

感谢 @939zzz、@xybigdata、@codexvn、@Guns160、@Drteammangel、@icucuio、@48ytw4q7zg-sudo、@Cu-debug178、@Wulianmiao 报告问题、提供复现信息和修复思路。

完整的技术细节请见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。

body:
```
NVIM v0.13.0-dev-2032+g254bec339c
Build type: RelWithDebInfo
LuaJIT 2.1.1793383622
```

## Release notes

- [Changelog](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/commit/254bec339ca59e7e0f9db16f22754281f88d380b) (fixes + features)
- [News](./runtime/doc/news.txt) (`:help news` in Nvim)

## Install

### Windows

#### Zip

1. Download **nvim-win64.zip** (or **nvim-win-arm64.zip** for ARM)
2. Extract the zip
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

#### MSI

1. Download **nvim-win64.msi** (or **nvim-win-arm64.msi** for ARM)
2. Run the MSI
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

Note: On Windows "Server" you may need to [install `vcruntime*.dll`](https://neovim.io/doc/install/#windows).

### macOS (x86_64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### macOS (arm64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (x86_64)

If your system does not have the required glibc version, try the (unsupported) [builds for older glibc](https://github.com/neovim/neovim-releases).

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage**
